content.original: The MCY-102 is an upgrade to the Mercury introduced in 3067 by the Word of Blake. This variant retains the engine, MASC, and armor of the MCY-99 but carries two major modifications. The first is the rebuilding of the chassis using Endo Steel. The change in the chassis construction and removal of one small and one medium laser allows for the second modification: the installation of an Improved C3 Computer, making it capable of operating with five other units in a C3i unit. Both of the remaining lasers were also changed out for extended range models. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: Considered the progenitor of the Nexus II, the NXS1-B variant of the standard NXS1-A intended to make the 'Mech more capable as a recon unit, the B variant completely restructures the 'Mechs arsenal and reworks the Nexus into a powerful scout 'Mech. Clad in four tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, the NXS1-B is capable of jumping up to one hundred and fifty meters and carries two ER Medium Lasers as its primary weapons. These are backed up by an ER Small Laser. What makes this Nexus variant so effective as a recon 'Mech is its Improved C3 unit that allows it to share targeting data with up to five allied units. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The BattleMech known as the Nexus was originally based on the Jackrabbit, a light scout and combat vehicle and infantry support 'Mech built for the Star League Defense Force by Skobel MechWorks. Ironically, the Jackrabbit ended testing two weeks before Stefan Amaris seized power on Terra and was instead primarily used by units loyal to Amaris against the SLDF in General Kerensky's drive to liberate the Terran Hegemony. Though the SLDF captured Skobel's plant relatively intact, thanks to the stigma of being used against his forces Kerensky ordered it shutdown and the unloved Jackrabbit disappeared into history outside of ComStar's records. With the Com Guards looking to recoup their grievous losses in the wake of the Battle of Tukayyid, in 3054 Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht ordered the Skobel plant reactivated, reworking the slower Jackrabbit into a fast and highly mobile recon striker 'Mech he renamed the Nexus.

content.original: The 2M is another upgrade of the Orion using Star League technology. Built in 3063 the 'Mech uses an Endo Steel chassis and utilizes ten double-strength heat sinks to save weight and for their greater heat-dissipation ability. For long-range combat, the ON2-M is armed with a Gauss Rifle as well as an LRM-15 linked to an Artemis IV FCS for increased accuracy. For closer ranges, the 'Mech has three medium pulse lasers. The ON2-M is armored with twelve and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The 4Z variant of the Pillager is built to provide an almost perfect long range sniper 'Mech. The new Stealth armor makes it harder to hit, as does the required Guardian ECM Suite. In order to do fit these changes, the 'Mech has had two medium lasers and the Large Laser removed. The remaining medium lasers have been upgraded to ER medium lasers. The Pillager has also replaced the XL engine with a standard engine and added CASE for more reliability, so the 'Mech can survive a side torso destruction. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: The largest BattleMech ever built by HildCo Interplanetary, the Pillager is built as a larger version of the Victor, and is intended for assaulting urban centers and hardened fortifications. These design parameters were paramount as the SLDF mobilized to wage the Reunification War. Later Pillagers were upgraded with more cutting-edge Star League technology. Production of the Pillager halted not because its facility was destroyed, but the advanced Gauss rifle and XL engine production lines had been obliterated by the end of the Second Succession War. Curiously, HildCo did not restart production of the original PLG-1N, rather the Pillager lines only began production again in 3058 when advanced components were once again available for the PLG-3Z.

content.original: One of the best first generation ProtoMechs, the Centaur combines high speed, decent armor, and a varied weapons mix. These features make it a flexible combatant, able to keep up with scout 'Mechs while supporting them. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. Адаптивная броня делает Purifier Adaptive гораздо более сложной мишенью, особенно когда она находится в неподвижном состоянии. Недостатком является количество брони, которое она несет.

The 'Mech's arsenal has also been stripped and upgraded, carrying four forward-mounted ER medium lasers and an MRM-30 launcher, a compromise between the LRMs and SRMs of past models, supplied by two tons of ammunition. content.original: The Quickdraw was originally built in 2779 as a replacement for the Rifleman BattleMech. While it was unsuccessful in supplanting the Rifleman, over time the Quickdraw proved itself to be a good generalist 'Mech. Packing excellent firepower, solid armor protection and above-average speed, it quickly earned the respect of many MechWarriors and status as a workhorse in every Successor State's military.

content.original: The first of the Raijin II designs, the 200-A model completely redesigns the 'Mech to enhance its combat capabilities and is built on an Endo Steel chassis to save weight. Increased ground speed is achieved through the use of Triple Strength Myomers that increases the 'Mech's top speed to 118.8 km/h under the proper conditions. The 200-A model is protected by a respectable eleven tons of standard armor; giving it superior armor protection to older models. The 'Mech is armed with an ER PPC as its primary weapon. This is supported by three ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 launcher for close combat. The RJN-200-A also carries a C3i Computer, allowing it to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Intended to act as a heavy scout, the 200-B uses the 200-A as its base. The 'Mech has Stealth Armor that makes it extremely hard to hit when activated and carries the ECM suite that is needed with any stealth armor system. The 'Mech also has a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and an improved C3 system. The only drawback to all of the advanced electronics is that when the stealth armor is activated the 'Mech is subject to its own ECM system, effectively blocking its own improved C3 system. The 200-B carries four ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser to defend itself. Additionally, to increase its survivability, the 200-B uses a light fusion engine. content.original: The 200-C takes the concept of the 101-A and the 200-B and combines the best of them making an agile, long-range sniper 'Mech that is extremely hard to hit. This is done by combining the light fusion engine, Stealth Armor and ECM suite of the 200-B model with the armament and Triple Strength Myomer of the 200-A model. The 200-C is armed with an ER PPC for long range combat which is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers. The 'Mech is also linked to an improved C3 network, making it one of the most impressive sniper 'Mechs. However, it should be noted that its stealth armor interferes with the C3 network while active, requiring the pilot to choose between improved accuracy or stealth. content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Stealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Стэлс Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Introduced by the Lyran Alliance in 3064, the STK-8S is built around a new Light Fusion Engine which frees up some tonnage for heavier weapons. The 8S is armed with two ER PPCs for long-range combat. When it closes with an enemy it can bring its new Heavy Gauss Rifle to bear at intermediate to short ranges. Finally, for short range combat, the 8S carries two Medium Pulse Lasers and two ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Changes in the way the Clans fight since they made contact with the Inner Sphere led scientists from Clan Steel Viper to revisit the Vapor Eagle. They stripped out all the weaponry, but left everything else alone. This variant is effective at long range, as it mounts a Clan Mk. XVII ER PPC. The Fang Series-A ATM 3 replaced the Machine Guns of the original, though it only mounts one ton of ammunition, so the launcher loses the all-important flexibility of the Advanced Tactical Missile System. For close range, three Series 5K Heavy Medium Lasers provide a powerful punch, while a pair of Pattern D-II SRM-2 launchers add more damage potential. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.content: Изменения в способах ведения боя Кланов после их контакта с Внутренней Сферой побудили ученых из клана Стальной Гадюки вернуться к рассмотрению шасси Vapor Eagle. Они удалили всё вооружение, но оставили всё остальное без изменений. Эта модификация эффективна на больших расстояниях, так как оснащена клановым Mk.XVII ER PPC. Fang Series-A ATM-3 встал на место пулеметов оригинальной модели, хотя он оснащен только одной тонной боеприпасов. На ближней дистанции три тяжелых средних лазера серии 5K обеспечивают мощный удар, а пара пусковых установок Pattern D-II SRM-2 добавляет еще больше потенциального урона. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.09

content.original: The 4L Vindicator is a major upgrade to the design, part of Ceres Metals' efforts to revive the line in 3063. The engine has been replaced with a 225-rated XL engine, granting the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and its jumping distance was increased to 150 meters with an additional jump jet. The 'Mech uses double heat sinks for its advanced weapons load, which includes an ER PPC and LRM-5 for striking power at long range and an ER medium laser and medium pulse laser for short range work. Finally, the 'Mech carries a Guardian ECM Suite and is protected with nine tons of Stealth Armor, making it harder to target at range. The 4L became a common design among Shadow Lances following their introduction. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Vindicator is one of the most well-known Capellan Confederation BattleMechs. This workhorse of the CCAF was originally built in 2826 between the First and Second Succession War to maximize the effectiveness of the Confederation's surviving production capabilities and fulfill as many roles as possible. Designed by committee, the Vindicator's 'jack-of-all-trades' nature means it does not excel in any one role but fulfills them adequately. With almost all of its components produced on Capella, the Vindicator is also cheap, easy to mass produce, and quick to repair with a ready supply of spare parts.

content.original: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Armed with a single Support PPC, the Void is capable of moderate suppressing fire against larger targets. The stealth armor ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields. Quirk: Void Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Вооружённый одной РРС, Void способен вести умеренный подавляющий огонь по крупным целям. Стелс-броня помогает минимизировать ответный огонь, а РРС гарантирует эффективность Void на большинстве полей сражений. Особенность: Void Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

For additional close-combat capability this version carries two Streak SRM-6 launchers while a C3 Slave Unit allows it to share targeting telemetry with friendly units but only carries thirteen double heat sinks. content.original: The 8D Wolverine is an one of two updated versions introduced by Kallon in 3066 that incorporates some of the newest equipment to the AFFS. The 'Mech is built with an Endo Steel chassis and uses an XL engine augmented with MASC, enabling speeds of up to 108 km/h. Its main gun is a Rotary Autocannon/2, backed up by an ER Medium Laser and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. Both the Rotary Autocannon and the ER Medium Laser are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, making the Wolverine extremely accurate. However the design carries only ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A modification of the Wraith made by the Word of Blake, the TR3 replaces the two Medium Pulse Lasers with two ER Medium Lasers while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The Ares Medium Tank (ATM) is designed to stand off and take down its enemies at long range. Its top speed of 86 km/h is fast for a fire support vehicle, so it is often paired with APC to support infantry. Four and a half tons of armor protect the vehicle and its crew; this somewhat meager amount encourages Ares crews to stay out of range of most return fire. The main weapon is an ER Large Laser mounted in the turret. Mounted in the front is an ATM-12. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. content.original: Introduced in 3054, the Cavalry Attack Helicopter was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 15 Left 90 15 Right 90 15 Rear 65 15 Total 360 75 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.

Подходящий скорее для тактики бей-и-беги, чем для боевых действий на передовой, Cavalry завоевал безупречную репутацию, при условии правильного использования. Аппарат может выдержать прямой удар от клановой ER PPC в носовую часть и продолжить полет. Ограничения биома: этот юнит не может действовать в лунных биомах. content.original: The Centipede Scout Car was produced by Gienah Combat Vehicles & Red Devil Industries in 3053. The vehicle was originally intended for reconnaissance ahead of its command unit to spot hidden units, but the Centipede SRM variant is a battlefield modification created during the FedCom Civil War in 3062 specifically altered to be utilized as a quick striker in hit and run attacks. It removes all original equipment of the standard model in favor of six SRM-2 missile launchers with a single ton of ammunition to significantly boost firepower at the cost of losing its advanced sensors and scouting capabilities. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. content.original: The Karnov UR Transport is a heavy lift VTOL which has been in service for hundreds of years. The tilt-rotor design is one of the fastest of its type in use. A reliable and hardy machine, all of the Successor State armed forces and many mercenary units employ Karnovs for supply and logistics missions. Many commercial firms also use the machine for local transportation of cargo in its sizable 6-ton bay or as a flying crane. Mounting a pair of ER Medium Lasers and two tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor, this Karnov variant can deploy battle armored infantry directly from its twelve ton cargo bay. To provide electronic protection a Guardian ECM Suite is mounted in the nose. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. content.original: Mounting a pair each of Rotary AC/5s and LB 2-X ACs, the 3067 RAC variant of the Partisan is able to pump out a significant amount of gunfire in a short amount of time. It also adds another ton of armor for increase durability. This 3069 variant also uses an XL engine, but mounts four Rotary AC/2s, a Targeting Computer, and a C3 slave unit to trade targeting data. The armor protection has been increased by nearly 45% over the base XL variant. Kallon Industries, famous for designing some of the most popular anti-aircraft 'Mechs in the Inner Sphere, designed the Partisan to bring those same capabilities onto a cheaper, more easily produced vehicle. Dedicated to destroying aircraft, its targeting system can track up to 200 targets at once, compute the optimal target, and link to the targeting systems of other Partisans in the unit. content.original: The 4S variant of the BattleMaster is a new look at an old 'Mech. Introduced by Red Devil Industries in cooperation with J.B. BattleMechs in 3062, the 4S is built on a StarFrame Heavy chassis, powered by a 340 VOX Light Fusion Engine, and armored with thirteen and a half tons of ArcShield Maxi X Ferro-fibrous armor. The long-range firepower comes from a Zeus Slingshot Gauss rifle in the right arm, fed by three tons of reloads in the right torso. The 'Mech also carries four RAMTech 1500Z ER medium lasers and two Defiance B3M medium lasers split between the side torso for intermediate ranges, as well as a TharHes Maxi SRM-6 with two tons of reloads and an Artemis IV fire control system in the left torso. For anti-infantry combat, this BattleMaster carries two Defiance P5S Small Pulse Lasers in the left arm and CASE to protect its munitions. The electronics were replaced by an O/P 3000 COMSET and a Cyclops Multi-Tasker 10 T&T system. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15

content.content: Построенный с использованием эндостали и покрытый семью тоннами брони из феррофибры уровня Внутренней Сферы, BTL-C-2O Battle Cobra оснащен более легким стандартным термоядерным двигателем рейтинга 200. Prime основан на своем клановом аналоге и оснащен большим импульсным лазером IS-класса в каждой руке, а также дополнительным двойным охладителем. Особенность: Расширенный поворот торса Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.97 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: Constructed using IS-grade Endo-Steel and clad in seven tons of Inner Sphere quality Ferro-Fibrous armor, the BTL-C-2O Battle Cobra mounts a lighter 200-rated standard fusion engine. While reducing its speed by 20 km/h, the extra weight was required to carry heavier IS-grade weapons as well as mount a fixed Improved C3 Computer in its center torso. An electronic warfare config, the BTL-C-2OA carries a TAG and a Guardian ECM Suite in its right arm and a Beagle Active Probe in its left. For protection, a trio of IS-grade Medium and a single Small Pulse Lasers are mounted in its left arm and three standard Medium Lasers in its right, also fitted with an additional double heat sink. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: Utilizing some of the newest technology available in the Capellan Confederation, the 7L was built by Tao 'Mechworks in 3067. It used Stealth Armor, making it harder to target. The 'Mech also used double heat sinks and is armed with two LRM-15 launchers, two Streak SRM-4 launchers, and two ER Medium Lasers. Finally, the 'Mech carried a Guardian ECM Suite to allow its Stealth Armor to work. In order to make room, the top speed was lowered to 53 km/h by replacing the engine with a Nissan Fusion 195, though jump jets offset that through increased maneuverability. Despite its Liao origins, half of the first production run was sold to the Word of Blake. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Originally envisioned as a refresh to the GRN-D-02, the -03 introduced so many changes that a new chassis designation was needed. Dubbed the Grand Crusader II, the 'Mech is still built on an Endo Steel chassis, but now carries a much larger 320 light fusion engine to give it a top speed of 64.8 km/h and a much greater amount of survivability than the XL engine carried by earlier models. The 03 also carries Triple Strength Myomer to increase its ground speed to 86.4 km/h as long as it is running hot. The 'Mech has four jump jets to further increase its mobility. The variant carries fifteen tons of armor protection and is armed with two ER Large Lasers as its primary weapons, backed up by an LRM-15 launcher with an Artemis IV fire control system. For close combat, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-6 missile launcher. The 'Mech also carries an improved C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting data with friendly units. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Capellans have rebuilt the Griffin from the skeleton up to take advantage of their new stealth armor. The engineers selected a XL fusion engine to allow for the larger LRM-15 launcher and Guardian ECM system; thirteen double-strength heat sinks are required to keep the design reasonably cool. Further upgrades include an Artemis IV targeting system to improve the accuracy of the missile rack and an ER PPC. Concerns about the fragility of using an XL engine was settled by allotting an additional 1.5 tons of armor. Finally, CASE protection for the ammunition bins was vital; while incapable of protecting the bulky engine, it allows the pilot to eject safely in the event of an ammunition explosion. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Concerns about the fragility of using an XL engine was settled by allotting an additional 1.5 tons of armor. Finally, CASE protection for the ammunition bins was vital; while incapable of protecting the bulky engine, it allows the pilot to eject safely in the event of an ammunition explosion. Особенность: Боевые кулаки Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Stealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Стэлс Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Intended to act as a heavy scout, the 200-B uses the 200-A as its base. The 'Mech has Stealth Armor that makes it extremely hard to hit when activated and carries the ECM suite that is needed with any stealth armor system. The 'Mech also has a TAG laser designator, a Beagle Active Probe, and an improved C3 system. The only drawback to all of the advanced electronics is that when the stealth armor is activated the 'Mech is subject to its own ECM system, effectively blocking its own improved C3 system. The 200-B carries four ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser to defend itself. Additionally, to increase its survivability, the 200-B uses a light fusion engine. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The 200-C takes the concept of the 101-A and the 200-B and combines the best of them making an agile, long-range sniper 'Mech that is extremely hard to hit. This is done by combining the light fusion engine, Stealth Armor and ECM suite of the 200-B model with the armament and Triple Strength Myomer of the 200-A model. The 200-C is armed with an ER PPC for long range combat which is backed up by two ER Medium Lasers. The 'Mech is also linked to an improved C3 network, making it one of the most impressive sniper 'Mechs. However, it should be noted that its stealth armor interferes with the C3 network while active, requiring the pilot to choose between improved accuracy or stealth. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Stealth Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only mount internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Стэлс Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. content.original: The 4L Vindicator is a major upgrade to the design, part of Ceres Metals' efforts to revive the line in 3063. The engine has been replaced with a 225-rated XL engine, granting the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and its jumping distance was increased to 150 meters with an additional jump jet. The 'Mech uses double heat sinks for its advanced weapons load, which includes an ER PPC and LRM-5 for striking power at long range and an ER medium laser and medium pulse laser for short range work. Finally, the 'Mech carries a Guardian ECM Suite and is protected with nine tons of Stealth Armor, making it harder to target at range. The 4L became a common design among Shadow Lances following their introduction. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A modification of the Wraith made by the Word of Blake, the TR3 replaces the two Medium Pulse Lasers with two ER Medium Lasers while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 kph. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A modification of the Wraith made by the Word of Blake, the TR3 replaces the two Medium Pulse Lasers with two ER Medium Lasers while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The 6D Hatchetman is a variant with a decidedly Davion flair. Created by Johnston Industries in 3062 the 6D is powered by a 225 extralight engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of up to 86.4 km/h and can jump up to 150 meters thanks to an extra jump jet. The 'Mech is armed with a RAC/5 as its primary weapon backed up by a trio of ER Medium Lasers and, for protection against electronic warfare systems, it has a Guardian ECM Suite. Finally the 6D is protected by nine tons of armor and mounts ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

The 'Mech replaces the 300-rated XL engine with a 300 light fusion engine. The 'Mech also removes all of its ranged weaponry and replaces it with seven ER medium lasers. When combined with the hatchet, the 'Mech is a monster, both against battle armor and in an urban environment. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The 6D Hatchetman is a variant with a decidedly Davion flair. Created by Johnston Industries in 3062 the 6D is powered by a 225 extralight engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of up to 86.4 km/h and can jump up to 150 meters thanks to an extra jump jet. The 'Mech is armed with a RAC/5 as its primary weapon backed up by a trio of ER Medium Lasers and, for protection against electronic warfare systems, it has a Guardian ECM Suite. Finally the 6D is protected by nine tons of armor and mounts ten double heat sinks. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: This Experimental prototype Tukogawa MBT began its development by Buda Imperial Vehicles on Luthien in 3067. The one-off vehicle was almost lost when Luthien fell into chaos with the dawn of the Jihad, and the supervising Technician, Roald Vu, was killed. During the recovery process in mid-3070s, the prototype was rediscovered. The DCMS decided to use this vehicle as testbed for new type of LRM launcher. The vehicle is fitted with a turreted mounted 15-tubed Extended Long Range Missile Launcher, with 2 tons of ammo. Co-axed with the launcher is a Class 10 Hyper-Velocity Autocannon with two tons of ammunition. To make room for these weapons, the vehicle's engine was changed out for a 280-rated XXL Fusion Engine. The new engine propelled the vehicle up to 80 km/h. To protect the fragile engine, the hull was given 8.5 tons worth of Clan Ferro-Fibrous Armor. A C3 Slave Computer is fitted to allow lancemates to coordinate fire against enemy forces. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 280 30 Left 220 30 Right 220 30 Rear 195 30 Turret 220 30 Total 1135 150 Quirk: Enhanced FPE

content.content: Этот экспериментальный прототип Tukogawa MBT начал разрабатываться компанией Buda Imperial Vehicles на Люсьене в 3067 году. Он был почти потерян, когда Люсьен погрузился в хаос с началом Джихада, а техник-руководитель Роальд Ву был убит. В ходе восстановительных работ в середине 3070-х годов прототип был переобнаружен. В DCMS решили использовать эту машину в качестве испытательного аппарата для нового типа LRM. В паре к ней - Hyper-Velocity Autocannon класса 10 с двумя тоннами боеприпасов. Чтобы освободить место для этого оружия, двигатель машины был заменен на 280 XXL Fusion Engine. Новый двигатель позволил разогнать машину до 80 км/ч. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 5/8 гексов / 150/240 метров. The Blue Flame is an extremely stable platform due to its quadrupedal configuration. In the later years of the Jihad, an engineer who had help build the Mech stole the design specs and later created the Thunder Fox.

content.original: The Grand Dragon is the successful follow-up to the Dragon BattleMech. Just like the Dragon, the Grand Dragon quickly became a favorite in the DCMS, with nearly every line unit fielding a company of either design. Production of the Grand Dragon continued unabated until the Jihad, when the Word of Blake devastated LAW's factories in 3068. It took two years for LAW to get new Grand Dragon factories up and running, the first on Nykvarn followed by Abiy Adi and Savinsville, and ensure the continued use of the 'Mech in years to come.

content.original: This failed experimental variant of the Hunchback was developed by Kali Yama Weapons Industries. Only four prototypes were produced in 3065, but no orders were placed for it. This experimental version of the 'Mech included CASE II, a Torso-Mounted Cockpit, Heavy Gyro, and was built using a Reinforced Structure. The 'Mech was protected by 9 tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor, and its armored and reinforced components enhanced its battlefield survivability. It was armed with a single Class 10 Ultra Autocannon carrying two tons of ammo. However, the design was considered too expensive for the reduction in firepower. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08

content.original: The Hunchback C is the antithesis of the Hunchback IIC used by other Clans, combining toughness and great ground speed with the heavy firepower of its autocannon. Piloted by Star Commander Matthew Wayne, of the Clan Ghost Bear's Seventh Phalanx. Disgraced after losing his OmniMech and from an insignificant Bloodhouse, he saw it as his only resort to take charge of a Hunchback of Lyran origins. However, heavy modifications to the 'Mech and his unrelenting desire to redeem himself led to him eventually being adopted by Delta Galaxy's Seventy-Third Battle Cluster, before he finally was killed while clearing Blakists during a glorious charge at Fell's Fort. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-O (Samual) is designed to engage infantry, with a single ER PPC retained to fight at range. 3 SRM-4’s and a pair of SRM-6’s are loaded with inferno rounds, whilst 5 Flamers and a pair of MG Arrays are used for close range fighting. A pair of B-Pods round out the configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.original: This Experimental prototype Tukogawa MBT began its development by Buda Imperial Vehicles on Luthien in 3067. The one-off vehicle was almost lost when Luthien fell into chaos with the dawn of the Jihad, and the supervising Technician, Roald Vu, was killed. During the recovery process in mid-3070s, the prototype was rediscovered. The DCMS decided to use this vehicle as testbed for new type of LRM launcher. The vehicle is fitted with a turreted mounted 15-tubed Extended Long Range Missile Launcher, with 2 tons of ammo. Co-axed with the launcher is a Class 10 Hyper-Velocity Autocannon with two tons of ammunition. To make room for these weapons, the vehicle's engine was changed out for a 280-rated XXL Fusion Engine. The new engine propelled the vehicle up to 80 km/h. To protect the fragile engine, the hull was given 8.5 tons worth of Clan Ferro-Fibrous Armor. content.original:
A Draconis Combine developed Omni mech, the Sunder is based on reverse engineered Loki and Thor Omnimechs. A 360-rated XL Engine allows the omnimech to carry 15 DHS along with 16.5 tons of armor and 36 tons of weapons. The Sunder SD1-O (Samual) is designed to engage infantry, with a single ER PPC retained to fight at range. 3 SRM-4’s and a pair of SRM-6’s are loaded with inferno rounds, whilst 5 Flamers and a pair of MG Arrays are used for close range fighting. A pair of B-Pods round out the configuration. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16

Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

'Hildr' is one such design fitted with a BattleMech Mace, capable of crushing armor and internal components in one blow, and a Snub-Nose PPC to finish off anything strong enough to be standing after its assaults. Четыре пушки излучателя частиц наделяют Annihilator-1E жёстким и невероятно мощным ударом, а средние лазеры от -1A были перенесены для ближнего боя, при этом броня несколько усилена.

content.original: Built for the Capellan Confederation by Earthwerks in 3067, the 7L variant of the Archer incorporated new Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite for protection against enemy electronics in addition to making the Archer harder to target. The 'Mech carried twelve and a half tons of Stealth Armor and was armed with two LRM-20 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers. The trade-off for this massive upgrade was that the 'Mech's top speed was reduced to 54 km/h. In an attempt to compensate for this, the 'Mech also had three jump jets mounted, making it capable of jumping up to ninety meters at a time. The 7L was slated to enter the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces' new Shadow Lances. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 8M variant of the Archer was built on an Endo Steel chassis and mixed elements of several past variants. Introduced in 3067 by Earthwerks for the Word of Blake Militia, this variant was armed with two Delta Dart LRM-15 launchers linked to Artemis IV fire control systems in either side torso and an Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser in the center torso for long-range combat. It also mounted three Diverse Optics Sunfire ER Medium Lasers for short ranged support, one in each arm and the third in its head. This made the 8M effective at all ranges and gave it both long-range direct and indirect capabilities. The 8M was protected by thirteen and a half tons of Maximilian 100 standard armor which was better slopped in order to deflect weapons fire more easily. It carried twelve double heat sinks, and had a similar speed profile to the original Archer. Its upper body traversing assembly was improved over the original to better protect its hip actuators and its feet were redesigned to make it a more stable firing platform, whether standing or on the move. Four tons of LRM reloads were split between the side torsos and were protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original:
A vicious anti-infantry variant, the origin of the Flea "Fire Ant" is a mystery, with Earthwerks denying the design. It was first seen in the Chaos March, most notably in urban fighting on Carver V, in 3063 and none were spotted after 3068. Possibly the predecessor to the 19 and 20, the exact configuration is not known (if one even exists, as it seems to be a refit variant of sorts). The typical Fire Ant refit removed half a ton of armor in favor of six Machine Guns and three Flamers. It was thought to be a designated pacification unit, in the sense of a SecurityMech, as opposed to a frontline BattleMech design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content:
Злой вариант для борьбы с пехотой. Происхождение этой Flea «Fire Ant» остаётся загадкой, поскольку Earthwerks отрицает его разработку. Впервые он был замечен на Марше Хаоса, в частности в городских боях на Carver V в 3063 году, и после 3068 года больше не появлялся. Возможно, это предшественник моделей -19 и -20, но точная конфигурация неизвестна (если она вообще существует, так как, по-видимому, это своего рода модифицированный вариант). Типичная модификация Fire Ant предполагала удаление полутонны брони в пользу шести пулеметов и трех огнеметов. Считалось, что это был спец юнит для усмирения беспорядков, мех охраны, в отличие от фронтовой модели боевого меха. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95

Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The definitive 'Project Phoenix' model, the 8D is intended as more of a line unit. It mounts two Mydron Model RC Rotary Autocannon/5s with six tons of ammunition split between the arms, a pair of Bright-Blossom ER Medium Lasers also mounted in each arm, eleven double heat sinks and twelve tons of Kallon Royalstar armor, the heaviest of any known Rifleman variant. Until the arrival of the 7X, it was also the only known Rifleman variant to mount jump jets, with two in either leg for a total jumping distance of 120 meters. To carry all this additional weight, the 8D uses a Kallon Type XV Endo Steel chassis and Hermes 240 XL engine, although it still mounts the same excellent Garret electronics. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Vulcan II VLC-N3 is roughly similar in layout to its predecessor. The N3 offers several new internal features, starting with its 280 extra light fusion engine and seven jump jets. The combination of an XL engine and an Endo Steel chassis permits the new design to carry eight and a half tons of Armor. The weaponry is equally impressive, the Vulcan II is equipped with 4 Small Pulse Lasers and 3 Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the techs installed eleven double heat sinks, enough to allow a Vulcan II pilot to run and fire all his weapons without overheating. However, jumping poses a problem for careless MechWarriors, and can quickly disable those who ignore the heat meter during a battle. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The VT-7M retains the Endo Steel skeleton and fusion engine of the VT-5M. However, technicians considered its jump capacity more than sufficient for urban combat, and so reduced it to 120 meters. The weight and space saved by removing the two Jump Jets allows the design to carry seven and one half tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor, the most protection this 'Mech has had at any time in its history. Furthermore, this is the first Vulcan to feature hand actuators. The new design features a Diverse Optics Extended Range Large Laser in the right torso and replaces the traditional arm-mounted Flamer with two Magna Medium Lasers, giving this Vulcan the punch to take on vehicles and light 'Mechs. A quartet of Magna Mk II Small Pulse Lasers fits snugly into the left arm; power conduits for this accurate anti-personnel array are routed along the same channel once used to feed that arm's single Machine Gun. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: Built for the Capellan Confederation by Earthwerks in 3067, the 7L variant of the Archer incorporated new Stealth Armor and a Guardian ECM Suite for protection against enemy electronics in addition to making the Archer harder to target. The 'Mech carried twelve and a half tons of Stealth Armor and was armed with two LRM-20 launchers and two ER Medium Lasers. The trade-off for this massive upgrade was that the 'Mech's top speed was reduced to 54 km/h. In an attempt to compensate for this, the 'Mech also had three jump jets mounted, making it capable of jumping up to ninety meters at a time. The 7L was slated to enter the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces' new Shadow Lances. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original: The 8M variant of the Archer was built on an Endo Steel chassis and mixed elements of several past variants. Introduced in 3067 by Earthwerks for the Word of Blake Militia, this variant was armed with two Delta Dart LRM-15 launchers linked to Artemis IV fire control systems in either side torso and an Diverse Optics Sunbeam ER Large Laser in the center torso for long-range combat. It also mounted three Diverse Optics Sunfire ER Medium Lasers for short ranged support, one in each arm and the third in its head. This made the 8M effective at all ranges and gave it both long-range direct and indirect capabilities. The 8M was protected by thirteen and a half tons of Maximilian 100 standard armor which was better slopped in order to deflect weapons fire more easily. It carried twelve double heat sinks, and had a similar speed profile to the original Archer. Its upper body traversing assembly was improved over the original to better protect its hip actuators and its feet were redesigned to make it a more stable firing platform, whether standing or on the move. Four tons of LRM reloads were split between the side torsos and were protected by CASE. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1

content.original:
A vicious anti-infantry variant, the origin of the Flea "Fire Ant" is a mystery, with Earthwerks denying the design. It was first seen in the Chaos March, most notably in urban fighting on Carver V, in 3063 and none were spotted after 3068. Possibly the predecessor to the 19 and 20, the exact configuration is not known (if one even exists, as it seems to be a refit variant of sorts). The typical Fire Ant refit removed half a ton of armor in favor of six Machine Guns and three Flamers. It was thought to be a designated pacification unit, in the sense of a SecurityMech, as opposed to a frontline BattleMech design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content:
Злой вариант для борьбы с пехотой. Происхождение этой Flea «Fire Ant» остаётся загадкой, поскольку Earthwerks отрицает его разработку. Впервые он был замечен на Марше Хаоса, в частности в городских боях на Carver V в 3063 году, и после 3068 года больше не появлялся. Возможно, это предшественник моделей -19 и -20, но точная конфигурация неизвестна (если она вообще существует, так как, по-видимому, это своего рода модифицированный вариант). Типичная модификация Fire Ant предполагала удаление полутонны брони в пользу шести пулеметов и трех огнеметов. Считалось, что это был спец юнит для усмирения беспорядков, мех охраны, в отличие от фронтовой модели боевого меха. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95

content.original: The definitive 'Project Phoenix' model, the 8D is intended as more of a line unit. It mounts two Mydron Model RC Rotary Autocannon/5s with six tons of ammunition split between the arms, a pair of Bright-Blossom ER Medium Lasers also mounted in each arm, eleven double heat sinks and twelve tons of Kallon Royalstar armor, the heaviest of any known Rifleman variant. Until the arrival of the 7X, it was also the only known Rifleman variant to mount jump jets, with two in either leg for a total jumping distance of 120 meters. To carry all this additional weight, the 8D uses a Kallon Type XV Endo Steel chassis and Hermes 240 XL engine, although it still mounts the same excellent Garret electronics. content.original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Vulcan II VLC-N3 is roughly similar in layout to its predecessor. The N3 offers several new internal features, starting with its 280 extra light fusion engine and seven jump jets. The combination of an XL engine and an Endo Steel chassis permits the new design to carry eight and a half tons of Armor. The weaponry is equally impressive, the Vulcan II is equipped with 4 Small Pulse Lasers and 3 Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the techs installed eleven double heat sinks, enough to allow a Vulcan II pilot to run and fire all his weapons without overheating. However, jumping poses a problem for careless MechWarriors, and can quickly disable those who ignore the heat meter during a battle. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

The weaponry is equally impressive, the Vulcan II is equipped with 4 Small Pulse Lasers and 3 Medium Pulse Lasers. Finally, the techs installed eleven double heat sinks, enough to allow a Vulcan II pilot to run and fire all his weapons without overheating. However, jumping poses a problem for careless MechWarriors, and can quickly disable those who ignore the heat meter during a battle. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: The VT-7M retains the Endo Steel skeleton and fusion engine of the VT-5M. However, technicians considered its jump capacity more than sufficient for urban combat, and so reduced it to 120 meters. The weight and space saved by removing the two Jump Jets allows the design to carry seven and one half tons of Ferro-Fibrous Armor, the most protection this 'Mech has had at any time in its history. Furthermore, this is the first Vulcan to feature hand actuators. The new design features a Diverse Optics Extended Range Large Laser in the right torso and replaces the traditional arm-mounted Flamer with two Magna Medium Lasers, giving this Vulcan the punch to take on vehicles and light 'Mechs. A quartet of Magna Mk II Small Pulse Lasers fits snugly into the left arm; power conduits for this accurate anti-personnel array are routed along the same channel once used to feed that arm's single Machine Gun. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

Sixteen double heat sinks are hard-pressed to dissipate all the waste heat, so care must taken when firing the weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Stealth is a heavy scout 'Mech that is in use by the Federated Suns and the Lyran Alliance. The 'Mech has a GM 315 XL Engine that allows the Stealth to move at speeds of 118.8 km/h and the MASC system on board can push the 'Mech to 151.2 km/h in short bursts. This amazing mobility is augmented by jump jets which the Stealth can use to jump up to two hundred and ten meters. The Stealth is also outfitted with a Cyclops-Beagle Sensory Active Probe that the Stealth can use to find hidden enemy units. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Мех имеет двигатель GM 315 XL, который позволяет Stealth двигаться со скоростью 118,8 км/ч, а бортовая система MASC может разгонять мех на короткое время до 151,2 км/ч. Такая удивительная мобильность дополняется прыжковыми двигателями, с помощью которых Stealth может прыгать на высоту до двухсот десяти метров. Stealth также оснащен сенсорным активным зондом Cyclops-Beagle, который можно использовать для поиска скрытых вражеских целей. Особенность: Точное оружие - Laser Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

Рамирез раздобыла несколько средних импульсных лазеров и парочку обычных средних и поручила своим техам установить всё вместо установки SRM-6. Вдобавок, она нарастила броню на пол тонны, слегка усилив не самый крепкий корпус.

content.original: The Wolfman was first created by Valdis Ullman, a MechWarrior belonging to the Legion of Vega, on Bergman's Planet during the Second Battle of Ryersson in 2986. Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

Originally piloting a Wolverine, his BattleMech was damaged in a fight with a Davion Marauder, with most of its upper body damaged or destroyed. Fortunately, a Davion Rifleman had been destroyed only a hundred meters away from his 'Mech. The Rifleman had suffered damage to its torso and legs. Ullman's personal technician, Sharis Brand thought that the two 'Mechs could be merged together, taking the intact legs and hips from Ullman's Wolverine and combining it with the torso and arms from the Rifleman. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The 8R has a large and varied arsenal built around energy weapons. For long-range combat, it has a single ER PPC. Once the Sagittaire gets its opponent in medium to close ranges it can bring its full fury to bear. Its primary weapons are a pair of Large Pulse Lasers backed up by five Medium Pulse Lasers, and finally a single Small Pulse Laser. All of these weapons are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing the Sagittaire to eviscerate its opponents in close combat. The Sagittaire SGT-8R has seventeen double heat sinks to handle its massive heat load, and is protected by eighteen tons of armor, allowing the 'Mech to stand up to a great deal of punishment in spite of its engine. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Sagittaire is built to fight in the confines of an urban battlefield. Weighing in at a massive ninety-five tons, the Sagittaire started production in mid-3063 and began to trickle out to units clamoring for close combat 'Mechs in the midst of the FedCom Civil War. As a power source, the 'Mech has a 285 XL engine. The XL engine saves weight at the cost of survivability and gives the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while its mobility is enhanced with three jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters.

content.original: The BL-12 was probably the most technologically advanced version of the Black Knight leading up to the Jihad. While still based on the original BL-6 model this design goes in a completely different direction from the BL-9. Introduced in 3063 the first thing that was done to the BL-12 was the upgrade of all of the medium lasers and the PPC to extended range versions, then its single heat sinks were upgraded to double strength versions, reducing the total number from twenty to sixteen. Finally, all of the weapons were mated to a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: The BL-13 was developed by the Free Worlds League, based on the surviving BL-7-KNT models. While it keeps the original large lasers, the remaining weapons were all replaced by a Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition, three extended range medium lasers and a head-mounted ER small laser. To improve the cooling the 'Mech was also switched to mount ten double heat sinks, Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: Newly developed by Clan Jade Falcon for the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere, the Black Lanner is a fast medium OmniMech that can take on a variety of roles. Intended as a front-line 'Mech, the Black Lanner makes use of all weight-saving technology available to the Clan Jade Falcon scientists who designed it, including an XL engine, endo steel, and eight tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Black Lanner also includes a MASC system on the base chassis that enables it to run up to 151 km/h in bursts, allowing it to outrun many 'Mechs half its size. The design sacrifices pod space for that speed however, with an engine almost half the Black Lanner's weight leaving a mere 13 tons for offensive weaponry.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: IS Standard Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандарт Вн. Сферы Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original:
Not to be confused with the Marauder IIC, the Marauder II C is a variant specially built for Wolf's Dragoons using Clan technology. The 'Mech is powered by a 400-rated XL Engine, which gives it a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h, matching the original Marauder; an endo steel chassis and ferro-fibrous armor offset the increased engine weight.[1] Additionally, the 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs, two ER medium lasers, and an LB-X Autocannon/10. Finally, the Marauder II C has excellent mobility provided by its jump jets with a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24

Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons.

Built around a 300-rated standard engine and three jump jets, nineteen tons of standard armor, twenty one single heat sinks, giving it a higher heat curve but more survivability in combat than the 4H. The design was exclusively used by various pirate groups. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18

content.original: While designing the IIC 2, Adder scientists retained the Medium Pulse Lasers, but exchanged the PPCs and small lasers for two Heavy Large Lasers and a ER Large Laser. The result is a hard-hitting design that is most effective at close range. In order to help the 'Mech get to close range, it includes four jump jets that are capable of vaulting the 'Mech up to 120 meters in a single bound. Three extra heat sinks enable the firing of all the close-range weapons. The weight left over was used in the form of an additional ton of armor, bringing it to twelve-and-a-half tons, equivalent to fifteen tons of standard armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: As with the Warhammer IIC, the Marauder IIC is ten-tons heavier than its Inner Sphere progenitor, pushing it into the assault weight class, but otherwise the design usually matches the original's ground speed. Though both designs carry over ten tons of armor, the Marauder IIC's use of more advanced ferro-fibrous plating gives it superior protection, with an endo steel frame freeing up weight. While structurally the Marauder IIC appears to offer little advantage over the LosTech refitted Marauders introduced by the Successor States, the blatant superiority of Clan weaponry allows the design to pound its opponents to pieces in short order.

content.original: Fighting against the powers of the Inner Sphere brought several harsh realities to light for Clan Jade Falcon, with one of the most glaring being their lack of effective reconnaissance and electronic warfare units in their touman. In an effort to rectify this issue, Jade Falcon engineers were tasked with upgrading the venerable Ostscout to Clan standards in 3063 and their prototype, dubbed the Ostscout IIC, displayed several excellent qualities for a scouting unit. These included being able to outpace even the infamous Fire Moth despite weighing 15 tons more, as well as a nearly 400 meter jump distance thanks to the coupling of a high volume of eleven jump jets with a Partial Wing.

content.original: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.content: «Страж» — средний боевой мех, построенный компанией Defiance Industries по эксклюзивному контракту для Лиранского Содружества в качестве меха поддержки пехоты и защиты объектов. Хотя поначалу они были рады иметь завод на тогда ещё территории Терранской Гегемонии, и производить мехов эксклюзивно для лиранцев, лиранцы стали менее довольны, когда поправка Совета Звёздной Лиги в 2652 году позволила Силам обороны Звёздной Лиги получить сильно улучшенную версию этого меха, которую Дома Штайнер, Марик и Дэвион получат лишь спустя годы. Sentinel был одним из многих проектов, пострадавших от технологического упадка Наследных войн: Defiance сначала потеряла возможность производить свои передовые системы вооружения, а затем полностью прекратила производство в 3014 году из-за нехватки как деталей, так и интереса. Вместо того, чтобы исчезнуть с поля боя, «Стражи» начали появляться во все большем количестве благодаря КомСтару и его огромному запасу материалов СОЗЛ. Материалы и сам мех они предоставили Синдикату Дракона до Войны 3039 года и использовали меха для оснащения своей комстражи. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper

content.original: The 5D is a Davion upgrade to the original, part of Kallon Industries' participation in the "Project Phoenix" initiative started by Vicore Industries. Imagined as a cavalry unit, the 5D removes the LRM-5 launcher and utilizes a RAC/5 in place of the original while also carrying two medium lasers, one in each arm, and a Streak SRM-4 mounted in the head. Two tons of autocannon ammo and one ton of Streak reloads are carried in the left torso, protected by CASE, while the nine and a half tons of armor are updated to ferro-fibrous. This model's jumping distance is also increased to 150 meters with five jump jets split between the rear torso areas.The use of an endo steel chassis frees enough weight to make these update possible. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: A multirole BattleMech developed in 2550 during the Golden Age, the Shadow Hawk is a powerful fusion of maneuverability and firepower. With a mix of long-range and short-range weapons, good maneuverability thanks to jump jets, and excellent endurance, the Shadow Hawk has long been regarded as one of the best 'Mechs in its weight class. The Shadow Hawk is equally adept whether commanding a reconnaissance company or serving as a spotter for heavy and assault lances.

Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. Shadow Hawk одинаково хорош как в роли командира развед роты, так и в качестве засветчика для тяжелых и штурмовых отрядов.

content.original: The 7CS is an electronics heavy, high tech upgrade of the Shadow Hawk built for ComStar in 3066. The 'Mech carries an UAC/5, an LRM-15 launcher mated to an Artemis IV fire control system, and two ER medium lasers, all linked to an improved C3 computer. Protection is provided by 10.5 tons of armor built on an endo steel chassis and powered by an extralight engine. As with other Project Phoenix 'Mechs, shortly after its introduction reports started coming in of Word of Blake units operating in the Chaos March equipped with 7CS Shadow Hawks. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Благодаря сочетанию оружия дальнего и ближнего боя, хорошей маневренности благодаря прыжковым двигателям и отличной выносливости, Shadow Hawk долгое время считался одним из лучших мехов в своей весовой категории. content.original: The 7M Shadow Hawk is Earthwerks' version of the Project Phoenix Shadow Hawk introduced in 3066, using some of the newest technologies available in the Free Worlds League. Based on the -5M, the 'Mech is built using an endo steel chassis with ten and a half tons of standard armor, with CASE for ammunition protection. While carrying many of the same weapons, it downsizes the LRM-20 rack to an LRM-15 and uses a light Gauss rifle in place of the UAC/5 for long-range sniping. This variant was later acquired by the Capellan Confederation, not only to supply their own forces but for their Trinity Alliance allies. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: The 5R variant was created by the Taurian Concordat with assistance from Word of Blake. This upgrade of the Stinger used three tons of Durallex Light Ferro-Fibrous armor, carried a Diverse Optics ER medium laser in the right arm and two Death Blossom RL-15s split between the side torsos. content.original: The new THG-13M Thug refit uses ferro-fibrous plates to regain the original Thug's level of protection. Twin ER large lasers have been installed, extending the Thug's effective reach. Also eliminated are the antiquated heat sinks; their place is taken by thirteen double-strength 'freezers' to better dissipate the new weapons' heat. The spaces freed up by these changes allow the short range launchers to be upgraded to four Streak SRM-4 racks. This massive missile battery is supported by three tons of CASE-protected reloads. Finally, the designers installed a Guardian electronic countermeasure suite to further proof the upgraded Thug against modern weapon systems. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor.

content.original: The THG-14M focuses on long-range striking power. The standard armor is replaced with ferro-fibrous plate, but total protection remains unchanged from the base 10E machine. All weapons are removed and the heatsinks are replaced with ten double heatsinks. Technicians first mounted an ER PPC in the torso. Next, they installed a Gauss rifle in the right arm, protected by CASE and supplied with two tons of ferro-nickel slugs. Finally, a cluster of five medium lasers are housed in the left arm. The result is a 'Mech with increased range and punch which sacrifices a bit of the 13M's short range firepower. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The Thunderbolt started production in 2491 as a planetary-assault 'Mech, and in fact was one of the heaviest 'Mechs that could be produced at that time. Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. With its varied arsenal, the Thunderbolt remains one of the best-armed 'Mechs, making it capable of serving in many roles. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

С тех пор классификация меха, ласково называемого T-Bolt, менялась по мере строительства более крупных мехов, но благодаря периодическим обновлениям его по-прежнему боятся и уважают многие. Благодаря своему разнообразному арсеналу Thunderbolt остаётся одним из наиболее вооруженных мехов, что делает его способным выполнять множество ролей. Однако одним из недостатков Thunderbolt является плохое управление теплом.

Since then the 'Mech, known affectionately as the T-Bolt, has had its classification changed as larger 'Mechs were built but thanks to periodic updates it is still feared and respected by many. It is also an incredibly well-armored 'Mech, rivaling or exceeding the amount of armor carried by some assault 'Mechs. One downside to the Thunderbolt though is poor heat management.

The 'Mech is armored with twelve tons of armor for protection and has an entirely updated weapons payload. The primary weapon is a RAC/5 which can fire at six times the normal rate of fire. Supporting it are three ER medium lasers and a Streak SRM-6. The lasers and rotary autocannon are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. Finally, for added protection against enemy electronics, the 'Mech has a Guardian ECM suite. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

Eleven Double Heat Sinks, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.

content.original: Developed from Word of Blake plans, the 3L variant uses the Capellan Confederation's new stealth armor and an Endo Steel chassis to make it more stealthy, mobile and survivable. Four tons of Stealth Armor provide superior protection and, along with a Guardian ECM suite, makes it harder to locate and hit the Wasp. The six jump jets were also relocated to the rear torso to better protect them and decrease cost. An ER medium laser is carried in the right arm and a RL-10 is mounted in the right torso; the inclusion of a Marian weapon to the 'Mech was controversial but nevertheless provided additional firepower. Despite other improvements, the 3L variant still carries 10 single heat sinks, a cost-cutting measure to take advantage of the Capellans' massive stockpile of these components. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: The BL-12 was probably the most technologically advanced version of the Black Knight leading up to the Jihad. While still based on the original BL-6 model this design goes in a completely different direction from the BL-9. Introduced in 3063 the first thing that was done to the BL-12 was the upgrade of all of the medium lasers and the PPC to extended range versions, then its single heat sinks were upgraded to double strength versions, reducing the total number from twenty to sixteen. Finally, all of the weapons were mated to a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The BL-13 was developed by the Free Worlds League, based on the surviving BL-7-KNT models. While it keeps the original large lasers, the remaining weapons were all replaced by a Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition, three extended range medium lasers and a head-mounted ER small laser. To improve the cooling the 'Mech was also switched to mount ten double heat sinks, Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight BL-15-KNT is an upgrade of the BL6-KNT. The antiquated single heat sinks were removed, along with the standard armor and all but three medium lasers. The BL-15-KNT instead mounts thirteen double heat sinks, a Gauss rifle, two ER large lasers, and three medium lasers. As a weight-saving measure, the BL-15 also uses ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

The 'Mech is no longer so neatly rounded, but it makes up for that with four ATM-3s and an ER medium laser. Three tons of ammunition allow the pilot access to all of the ATM's modes of fire, and it runs cool. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: IS Standard Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
