content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандарт Вн. Сферы Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Not to be confused with the Marauder IIC, the Marauder II C is a variant specially built for Wolf's Dragoons using Clan technology. The 'Mech is powered by a 400-rated XL Engine, which gives it a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h, matching the original Marauder; an endo steel chassis and ferro-fibrous armor offset the increased engine weight.[1] Additionally, the 'Mech is armed with two ER PPCs, two ER medium lasers, and an LB-X Autocannon/10. Finally, the Marauder II C has excellent mobility provided by its jump jets with a jumping distance of one hundred and twenty meters. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24

content.original: While designing the IIC 2, Adder scientists retained the Medium Pulse Lasers, but exchanged the PPCs and small lasers for two Heavy Large Lasers and a ER Large Laser. The result is a hard-hitting design that is most effective at close range. In order to help the 'Mech get to close range, it includes four jump jets that are capable of vaulting the 'Mech up to 120 meters in a single bound. Three extra heat sinks enable the firing of all the close-range weapons. The weight left over was used in the form of an additional ton of armor, bringing it to twelve-and-a-half tons, equivalent to fifteen tons of standard armor. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.19 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Sentinel is a medium BattleMech built by Defiance Industries, originally under exclusive contract for the Lyran Commonwealth, as an infantry support and installation defense 'Mech. While initially pleased to have a then Terran Hegemony controlled factory manufacturing the 'Mech exclusively for the LCAF, the Lyrans were less so when a Star League Council amendment in 2652 permitted the Star League Defense Force to purchase a highly advanced version of the design which Houses Steiner, Marik and Davion would not receive until years later. The Sentinel was one of many designs to suffer from the technological decline of the Succession Wars era, with Defiance first losing the ability to manufacture its advanced weapon systems before discontinuing production entirely in 3014 due to lack of both parts and interest. Rather than disappear from the battlefield, the Sentinel now began to appear in increasing numbers thanks to ComStar and its massive stockpile of SLDF material, both providing the design to the Draconis Combine prior to the War of 3039 and using it to help outfit its Com Guards. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper

content.content: «Страж» — средний боевой мех, построенный компанией Defiance Industries по эксклюзивному контракту для Лиранского Содружества в качестве меха поддержки пехоты и защиты объектов. Хотя поначалу они были рады иметь завод на тогда ещё территории Терранской Гегемонии, и производить мехов эксклюзивно для лиранцев, лиранцы стали менее довольны, когда поправка Совета Звёздной Лиги в 2652 году позволила Силам обороны Звёздной Лиги получить сильно улучшенную версию этого меха, которую Дома Штайнер, Марик и Дэвион получат лишь спустя годы. Sentinel был одним из многих проектов, пострадавших от технологического упадка Наследных войн: Defiance сначала потеряла возможность производить свои передовые системы вооружения, а затем полностью прекратила производство в 3014 году из-за нехватки как деталей, так и интереса. Вместо того, чтобы исчезнуть с поля боя, «Стражи» начали появляться во все большем количестве благодаря КомСтару и его огромному запасу материалов СОЗЛ. Материалы и сам мех они предоставили Синдикату Дракона до Войны 3039 года и использовали меха для оснащения своей комстражи. Особенность: Улучшенная связь Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.02 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper

content.original: The 5D is a Davion upgrade to the original, part of Kallon Industries' participation in the "Project Phoenix" initiative started by Vicore Industries. Imagined as a cavalry unit, the 5D removes the LRM-5 launcher and utilizes a RAC/5 in place of the original while also carrying two medium lasers, one in each arm, and a Streak SRM-4 mounted in the head. Two tons of autocannon ammo and one ton of Streak reloads are carried in the left torso, protected by CASE, while the nine and a half tons of armor are updated to ferro-fibrous. This model's jumping distance is also increased to 150 meters with five jump jets split between the rear torso areas.The use of an endo steel chassis frees enough weight to make these update possible. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Based on the -5M, the 'Mech is built using an endo steel chassis with ten and a half tons of standard armor, with CASE for ammunition protection. While carrying many of the same weapons, it downsizes the LRM-20 rack to an LRM-15 and uses a light Gauss rifle in place of the UAC/5 for long-range sniping. content.original: The new THG-13M Thug refit uses ferro-fibrous plates to regain the original Thug's level of protection. Twin ER large lasers have been installed, extending the Thug's effective reach. Also eliminated are the antiquated heat sinks; their place is taken by thirteen double-strength 'freezers' to better dissipate the new weapons' heat. The spaces freed up by these changes allow the short range launchers to be upgraded to four Streak SRM-4 racks. This massive missile battery is supported by three tons of CASE-protected reloads. Finally, the designers installed a Guardian electronic countermeasure suite to further proof the upgraded Thug against modern weapon systems. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The THG-14M focuses on long-range striking power. The standard armor is replaced with ferro-fibrous plate, but total protection remains unchanged from the base 10E machine. All weapons are removed and the heatsinks are replaced with ten double heatsinks. Technicians first mounted an ER PPC in the torso. Next, they installed a Gauss rifle in the right arm, protected by CASE and supplied with two tons of ferro-nickel slugs. Finally, a cluster of five medium lasers are housed in the left arm. The result is a 'Mech with increased range and punch which sacrifices a bit of the 13M's short range firepower. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14

content.original: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower. The Thugs long range striking power comes from a pair of arm mounted PPC’s. Backing up the PPCs are two SRM-6 launchers mounted in either side torso with one ton of CASE-protected reloads. Eighteen double heat sinks comfortably dissipate the enormous heat generated by the PPC’s while an Endo Steel frame allows it to carry fifteen and a half tons of armor.

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The 4L was a variant built for the Capellan Confederation by Ceres Metals starting in 3066. The design used a Taurian-produced standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The 'Mech carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially designed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. One of the more radical changes was the use of eight tons of Ceres Metals Stealth Armor, making the Phoenix Hawk harder to target at range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

The design used a Taurian-produced standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The 'Mech carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially designed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. content.original: Following the move of Clan Ghost Bear to the Inner Sphere, Khan Bjorn Jorgensson ordered the creation of a new BattleMech. The Arcas was designed as a symbol to mark the beginning of a new era, so Loremaster Laurie Tseng named it after a character in the mythology of the Greeks who eventually became the constellation known as Ursa Minor. First produced in 3061, the Arcas is expensive for a second-line 'Mech. It utilizes an XL engine that enables it to move up to 86 km/h and jump jets for a maximum jump capacity of one hundred fifty meters at a time. The Arcas mounts thirteen and a half tons of standard armor, the most a 'Mech of its size can carry.

content.original: The Blood Kite is a BattleMech that was designed on the orders of Clan Blood Spirit Khan Ceana Boques following the deployment of the OmniMech by Clan Coyote in 2854. Because Khan Boques expected the Trials for the OmniMech technology to escalate to the point that her small Clan's touman would not be able to compete, she ordered her scientist caste to rethink the way they designed 'Mechs. Boques dictated that this design philosophy was to conform to four points that seem like they would be common sense: be as cheap as is reasonable, have a reasonable chance of surviving an engagement, sustain a steady barrage, and be as efficient as possible. In fact, many prior designs created by the Clan's scientists violated many or all of these principles. The cream of this crop was the Blood Kite, which debuted in the early part of the thirtieth century. The Blood Kite eschews the use of expensive technology and weapons, only making use of an Endo Steel internal structure to save weight. It contains as much standard armor as the engineers could fit onto the eighty-five ton frame, as well as jump jets that propel it up to ninety meters at a time.

content.original: Designed to compete with 'Mechs like the Atlas and King Crab, the Cerberus is a 'Mech designed around speed and firepower. The Cerberus uses a massive GM 380 XL engine to propel it to a top speed of 64.8 km/h. The 'Mech is also armored with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous armor, which provides more protection per ton than standard armor. The large amount of free weight on the 'Mech, almost half of its mass, is dedicated to its weapons systems, which are designed to do as much damage to an enemy at as great a distance as possible.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Colossus was one of the first 'Mechs to use X-Pulse Lasers. Bethel Labs, the developers of the X-Pulse technology, wanted a demonstrator for their new technology. Omnitech Industries brushed off their Colossus design and the rest is history. Using a standard engine, Endo Steel chassis, and armor, the Colossus can take enormous amounts of damage. Though not a particularly fast 'Mech, it does move at the same rate as the Atlas and other assault 'Mechs. In addition it has a 90 meter jump capability which can maneuver it out of trouble.

content.original: Built on an endo steel frame and powered by a 270 XL engine, the Daedalus is a fast medium 'Mech able to reach top speeds of 97.2 km/h. This speed is enhanced further by Triple Strength Myomer, allowing the Daedalus to reach speeds of 118.8 km/s when properly heated up. Six jump jets further increase mobility, allowing the Daedalus to leap 180 meters in a single bound. The Daedalus wields a heat intensive, all energy loadout. The main armament is a large X-Pulse laser, backed up by four ER medium lasers and two ER small lasers, all tied to a targeting computer for superior accuracy. Heat is managed by 12 double heat sinks, which are barely able to manage the heat, but allows the 'Mech's TSM to be activated quickly. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

The Daikyu attempts to dictate the range at which it engages with its top speed of 86.4 km/h, which allows the Daikyu to keep up with most medium and heavy 'Mechs and makes it capable of outpacing most assault 'Mechs. The Daikyu is also well protected with twelve tons of armor and CASE to protect against ammunition explosions.

content.original: The Falcon Hawk has what is probably the longest development time of any 'Mech in history. Originally engineered and designed in 2794, the rapid loss of technology during the Succession Wars delayed its production until 3057, and even then only thanks to the recovery of a Star League memory core on Helm by the Gray Death Legion. The Falcon Hawk is powered by an 175 XL engine that provides a top speed of 86.4 km/h, making it relatively slow for its weight class. This is done so the Falcon Hawk could carry the weapons needed for its role as a long-range sniper. The 'Mech carries seven tons of armor to protect it from return fire.

content.original: The Garm is designed to operate as part of a fire support lance, providing long-range direct fire for other units, and as such, the Garm competes directly with the Valkyrie BattleMech. To make the Garm capable of carrying the weapons needed to carry out its intended mission, it is built on an endo steel chassis that weighs half as much as a standard chassis, while an 175 fusion engine allows it a maximum speed of 86.4 km/h. The mobility enjoyed by the Garm is enhanced with five Rawlings 80-beta jump jets that make the 'Mech capable of jumping up to 150 meters. The Garm does have relatively light armor for a 'Mech of its size, with only three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor; this is because the Garm depends on its ability to engage an enemy at long range rather than closing to short ranges.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Hachiwara was commissioned by the Silver Dragon Stables and designed by the Crosby BattleMech Research firm responsible for the creation of the No-Dachi. Using the No-Dachi as their inspiration, the Crosby engineers designed a 'Mech optimized for arena combat. The already high speed was increased by using a Supercharger, allowing the Hachiwara pilot to get in close to an opponent quickly. Twelve tons of armor protects the 'Mech. Harkening back to the samurai ideal, the Hachiwara uses a Vibroblade in place of the No-Dachi's Sword.

content.original: Developed by the Solaris VII-based Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the Jackal was designed to give as equal of a performance as possible to a Clan 'Mech of equal weight. While intended for the battlefield rather than the arenas, the prototype's stellar run on Solaris attracted the attention of number of 'Mech manufacturers, most notably Earthwerks Incorporated of Keystone. While Earthwerks ultimately secured the main production rights to the design, VEST was allowed to maintain limited garage level production as well.

content.original: The Lightray was designed by Martinson Armaments to be a heavy scout 'Mech. The Lightray is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis to help maximize the available weight for weapons and equipment, and features a gigantic 385 XL engine, the largest that can possibly be carried by a 'Mech its size. This engine allows the scout 'Mech to outpace most other medium designs with a top speed of 118 km/h, though it lacks the added maneuverability that could be provided by jump jets. The Lightray carries ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving the 'Mech a great deal of protection

content.original: Built on an endo steel frame and powered by a 270 XL engine, the Daedalus is a fast medium 'Mech able to reach top speeds of 97.2 km/h. This speed is enhanced further by Triple Strength Myomer, allowing the Daedalus to reach speeds of 118.8 km/s when properly heated up. Six jump jets further increase mobility, allowing the Daedalus to leap 180 meters in a single bound. The Daedalus wields a heat intensive, all energy loadout. The main armament is a large X-Pulse laser, backed up by four ER medium lasers and two ER small lasers, all tied to a targeting computer for superior accuracy. Heat is managed by 12 double heat sinks, which are barely able to manage the heat, but allows the 'Mech's TSM to be activated quickly. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Named for the ancient Japanese longbow and first produced in 3055, the Daikyu is armed to strike an enemy with a powerful blow at long range and, as such, is poorly armed for short-range combat. The Daikyu attempts to dictate the range at which it engages with its top speed of 86.4 km/h, which allows the Daikyu to keep up with most medium and heavy 'Mechs and makes it capable of outpacing most assault 'Mechs. The Daikyu is also well protected with twelve tons of armor and CASE to protect against ammunition explosions.

content.original: The Great Wyrm was one of the first unique Clan BattleMechs ever developed. Clan Mongoose scientists used the specifications for the Dragon as the basis for their new creation, and were able to update it to their liking in a little more than a year. Not only was it designed to Clan specifications, but the Mongoose creators reduced the Dragon's weight by 15 tons. The Great Wyrm first saw action in 2844 against Clan Star Adder, and soon found its way into the touman of every Clan. With the development of the OmniMech, however, the Great Wyrm was reduced to a solahma unit and production finally ceased in 2872.

content.original: The Hercules was built in response to a request by the Free Worlds League for a 'Mech with balanced mobility and firepower. The Hercules is powered by a 350 XL engine that propels the 'Mech up to speeds of 86.4 km/h. The Hercules is also well armored, with eleven tons of Heavy ferro-fibrous for protection. Overall, the Hercules has turned out to be a good all-around trooper 'Mech that can handle a variety of combat roles, from air defense to long-range direct fire support.

content.original: Created in 3058 in response to a call from Kurita to build more cost-effective BattleMechs with which to combat the Clans, the Akuma was designed by Independence Weaponry as a low-cost alternative to their Atlas variant. The Akuma actually shares several components with the Atlas and, much like that design, also features a head design intended to evoke fear in its enemies. The Akuma is built on a Foundation AKU Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a rugged and reliable GM 270 fusion engine that allows the 'Mech to reach a top speed of 54.0 km/h. The 'Mech has thirteen double heat sinks to dissipate waste heat and carries seventeen and a half tons of Durallex Special Heavy armor for protection from enemy fire.

content.original: The late 3050s and early 3060s saw the Absorption of Clan Burrock by Clan Star Adder. After the proof of collusion with the Bandit Caste, most Burrocks were eager to be rid of the taint of corruption. The Star Adders read this as a desire to join a more powerful Clan, so they were surprised when many former Burrocks clung to that identity. In order to appeal to them, the Star Adder leadership authorized a new BattleMech to honor them. The Burrock is a fast heavy 'Mech with incredible short-range firepower. Though its XL engine leaves it somewhat vulnerable, the Burrock is protected by twelve and a half tons of armor.

content.original: The Gurkha was developed by the Word of Blake in response to a request from Precentor Martial Cameron St. Jamais to keep the production lines on Terra running. To open up as much space as possible for weapons and equipment, the Gurkha is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis and is powered by a lightweight XL engine that gives it a top speed of 118.8 km/h. That, combined with the Gurkha's seven and a half tons of armor, make taking the 'Mech down a difficult proposition. Its only real deficiency is its lack of jump jets, which make maneuvering in limiting terrain difficult for the 'Mech. As the Word of Blake's opponents realized the power of this little 'Mech, Gurkhas quickly became targets to be eliminated quickly, as the C3i computer often means that an individual MechWarrior can rapidly find him or herself attacked by up to six extremely accurate 'Mechs.

content.original: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. content.original: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Afreet is a battle armor design created by Clan Ice Hellion. The Afreet was created when Khan Raina Montose ordered two other projects merged, resulting in a battlesuit that seems to fit in well with the Hellion belief in speed over all else. The primary feature of the Afreet is its ability to leap one hundred twenty meters at a time. This comes at a sacrifice to armor, as the Afreet is only able to stop a Clan ER Small Laser. It does, however, use Improved Sensors, a holdover from one of the suits it descended from. Following the Hellion invasion of the Inner Sphere, both Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses salvaged and produced their own versions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Африт» — это боевая броня, разработанная кланом Ледяного Хеллиона. «Африт» был создан после того, как хан Райна Монтозе приказала объединить два других проекта, в результате чего получился боевой костюм, который, похоже, хорошо вписывается в веру Хеллионов в превосходство скорости над всем остальным. Главной особенностью «Африта» является его способность прыгать на сто двадцать метров за раз. Это достигается за счёт снижения брони, «Африт» способен выдержать огонь максимум одного малого ER-лазера. Однако он использует улучшенные сенсоры, унаследованные от одного из костюмов, от которого он произошёл. После вторжения Хеллионов во Внутреннюю Сферу, клан Нефритового Сокола и клан Адских Лошадей собрали и создали свои собственные версии. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Balar was designed by Luthien Armor Works and released alongside the Avatar as a competitor to the Inner Sphere's first OmniMech design. While the Avatar was based upon the clan's Vulture OmniMech, the Balar took cues from the Ebon Jaguar instead. Sporting an impressive 350-rated XL fusion engine, the Balar was fast for a 70-ton 'Mech, but prohibitively expensive, which ultimately caused the design to be mostly overlooked by Combine procurement agents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

content.content: «Балар» был разработан компанией Luthien Armor Works и выпущен одновременно с Avatar в качестве конкурента первой модели омнимеха, созданной во Внутренней Сфере. В то время как Avatar был основан на клановом омнимехе Vulture, Balar был создан по образцу Ebon Jaguar. Оснащенный впечатляющим двигателем 350 XL, Balar был быстрым для 70-тонного меха, но чрезмерно дорогим, что в конечном итоге привело к тому, что его конструкция была в основном проигнорирована закупщиками Синдиката. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The BL-12 was probably the most technologically advanced version of the Black Knight leading up to the Jihad. While still based on the original BL-6 model this design goes in a completely different direction from the BL-9. Introduced in 3063 the first thing that was done to the BL-12 was the upgrade of all of the medium lasers and the PPC to extended range versions, then its single heat sinks were upgraded to double strength versions, reducing the total number from twenty to sixteen. Finally, all of the weapons were mated to a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight was designed both as a front-line combatant and as a command BattleMech at the company and battalion level for the Star League Defense Force. Its advanced communications gear allowed the Black Knight to effortlessly coordinate an entire company of 'Mechs simultaneously, and could easily link together the command frequencies of an entire parent regiment and connect with orbital support satellites. Advanced building materials gave the Black Knight a light but strong chassis able to carry more weapons and armor for less weight. Given the type and amount of firepower the 'Mech carries the only issue facing the Black Knight is heat management.

content.content: «Чёрный рыцарь» был разработан как боевая машина первой линии, так и как командный боевой мех на уровне роты и батальона для Сил обороны Звездной Лиги. Его передовое коммуникационное оборудование позволяло Black Knight без труда координировать действия целой роты мехов одновременно, а также легко соединять командные частоты всего родительского полка и связываться с орбитальными спутниками поддержки. Современные строительные материалы обеспечили Black Knight легким, но прочным шасси, способным нести больше оружия и брони при меньшем весе. Учитывая тип и количество огневой мощи, которую несет мех, единственной проблемой Black Knight является управление тепловыделением.

content.original: The BL-13 was developed by the Free Worlds League, based on the surviving BL-7-KNT models. While it keeps the original large lasers, the remaining weapons were all replaced by a Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition, three extended range medium lasers and a head-mounted ER small laser. To improve the cooling the 'Mech was also switched to mount ten double heat sinks, Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight BL-15-KNT is an upgrade of the BL6-KNT. The antiquated single heat sinks were removed, along with the standard armor and all but three medium lasers. The BL-15-KNT instead mounts thirteen double heat sinks, a Gauss rifle, two ER large lasers, and three medium lasers. As a weight-saving measure, the BL-15 also uses ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. content.original: Debuting during the FedCom Civil War but not gaining traction until recently, the Command COM-7T, also known as the 'Blazing Inferno II', carries the spirit of the popular Succession Wars variant into a new age. This refit runs hot even with its double heat sinks, but the installation of Triple-Strength Myomers turns the heat into a benefit. Though still a competent scout, the COM-7T's prodigious volume of fire more often sees it deployed as a striker. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

content.original: Long the darling of the Lyran Commonwealth's scouting formations, the Commando has enjoyed vast success over its seven centuries of service. Once exclusively Lyran, the Succession Wars spread the capable little 'Mech to various mercenary companies, where a score of variants commonly called the -7 series emerged. Thrifty mercenaries often swap missile racks for energy independence, and the Commando is a common sight in Mech-it-Lube franchise refit bays.

content.content: Издавна любимец развед формирований Лиранского Содружества, «Коммандо» добился огромного успеха за семь веков службы. Когда-то этот маленький мех был исключительно лиранским, но во время Наследных войн он распространился среди различных наёмных юнитов, в результате чего появилось множество вариантов, обычно называемых «-7 серией». Экономные наёмники часто меняют ракетные установки ради энергетической независимости, и «Коммандо» — обычное явление в ремонтных ангарах филиалов Mech-it-Lube.

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.original: The Grenadier is a battle armor design created by the Hahm-Heinz Design Bureau. The firm has long had a relationship with General Motors' secondary plants on Talcott and Salem, so when the NAIS first started creating battle armor, Hahm-Heinz had access to prototypes that they could work from. The armor is where the Grenadier is lacking, having only enough to stop an Inner Sphere Large Pulse Laser, the same amount as the venerable Inner Sphere Standard. This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Гренадер» — это боевая броня, разработанная конструкторским бюро Hahm-Heinz. Компания давно сотрудничает со вспомогательными заводами General Motors в Талкотте и Салеме, поэтому, когда NAIS впервые приступила к созданию боевой брони, Hahm-Heinz получила доступ к прототипам, на основе которых можно было работать. Броня — это слабое место Гренадера, поскольку она способна остановить только большой импульсный лазер Внутренней Сферы, то есть столько же, сколько и у почтенного Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Однако эта броня является стандартной стелс-броней, поэтому Гренадер несколько сложнее для выцеливания. content.original: The Griffin 6P is an early prototype of what would eventually become the 6S. However, since it uses Streak SRM rather than LRM launchers and mounts so many medium lasers without enough cooling, it was felt it strayed too far from the core concept of the Griffins, and was eventually rejected for mass production. content.original: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti-air and anti-mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either its own launcher or the rest of its lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with its armor unable to stand up to much punishment. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.original: Originally developed by Clan Fire Mandrill during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 120-rated XL Engine the Howler HWR-2 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 4 ATM-3’s with 2 tons of ammo. MASC boosts the Mechs speed. content.original: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Инфильтратор Мк II» - это боевая броня, разработанная в качестве замены более ранней модели Infiltrator Mk I. Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: As Autocannon development continued in the early 3060s, rotary autocannons became available. The MAL-2D gained mass for the increasingly massive cannons by downgrading the shoulder box launchers to medium-range missiles. As both the lasers and missiles were now all but vestigial, the MAL-2D became a developmental cul-de-sac. Though doubtlessly effective, it had poor mission endurance and did not offer tangible improvements in firepower. content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Morpheus is a heavily-armored combatant. The high ground speed allow the Morpheus to close quickly, while the heavy armor protects the 'Mech and pilot from enemy fire. The Morpheus is basically a larger version of the Tsunami medium arena fighter, and the engineers of Omnitech Industries learned many lessons from the Tsunami's disappointing appearance. Strangely, one thing they didn't bring over to the Morpheus was triple strength myomer.

content.original: The Naginata is designed as a command and fire support 'Mech. The 'Mech is built using a massive 285 fusion engine, giving it a top speed of 54 km/h. The Naginata makes use of double heat sink technology for its added heat dissipation capabilities to handle the waste heat that is produced by the 'Mech's massive arsenal. For protection, the Naginata carries fifteen tons of armor and includes CASE to protect against an ammunition explosion. The mix of heavy armor, CASE, and a standard engine make the Naginata a zombie of a 'Mech that can take a tremendous amount of damage.

content.original: The Nighthawk is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Originally developed for use in the arenas of Solaris VII, the 9SS is produced by Norse-Storm. The long-range weaponry of the 9J is removed and replaced with an Ultra Autocannon/20 and an LB-X Autocannon/20. The two guns are each incredibly powerful at short range, enabling the 9SS to obliterate enemies incredibly quickly. Three tons of ammunition for each ensure that this variant of the Nightstar has some staying power. A half of a ton of armor is removed to make way for three jump jets, enabling the 9SS to vault up to ninety meters at a time so that it can more effectively bring its autocannons to bear. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannons and provide the only firepower should they run out of ammunition. Also of note is the loss of both lower arm and hand actuators to make space for the weapons and equipment fielded. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.

content.original: Following the Abjuration of Clan Nova Cat, Khan Santin West ordered a team of scientists who had been captured from Clan Smoke Jaguar to design a BattleMech that could be produced in the Inner Sphere. They attempted to create a 'Mech similar to the Pack Hunter, but ER PPCs were sparse at the time, however the team got its break when the Nova Cats acquired a cache of heavy large lasers from Clan Diamond Shark in 3065. They had to rework the original concept of duplicating the Pack Hunter, which eventually became the Ocelot.

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The largest gun on the Pinion is its heavy large laser. Although it experiences some targeting difficulties, it packs a strong punch into a relatively small package. On the opposite end of the spectrum are the four micro pulse lasers mounted in the Pinion's torso. These weapons are only useful at point-blank range, but the pulse technology makes them quite accurate, and make the Pinion devastating against conventional infantry. The medium pulse lasers have a decent range and are highly accurate and provide reliable, mid-range firepower. This all-energy weapon configuration allows the 'Mech to range far and wide without having to worry about resupply or ammunition explosions in combat. 14 double heat sinks keeps the 'Mech fairly cool, though an alpha strike will seriously overheat it. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: The Pinion is part testbed, part leftovers. Developed by Clan Jade Falcon and introduced into service in 3065, the Pinion BattleMech is the second Clan 'Mech to be produced by Olivetti Weapons on Sudeten. The second-line BattleMech was designed as a patrol and guard duty 'Mech, so it has modest speed coupled with good maneuverability thanks to its jump jet range of 150 meters. Additionally, the Pinion is meant to test the effectiveness and drawbacks of heavy lasers, as early reports from Clan Star Adder indicated heavy lasers are unreliable and possibly damaging to the MechWarrior. In order to properly judge the effect of this new weapon, the Falcons decided to use garrison MechWarriors as guinea pigs. Their vitals were carefully tracked and medical evaluations were administered weekly as part of these tests.

content.original: Named for the array of spikes embedded in its armor, the Porcupine is built by Innovative Design Concepts to fulfill a highly unusual niche for a light dueling 'Mech: charge specialist. No expense was spared in order to make the Porcupine as effective in this role as possible, with the 'Mech powered by a 180 XL engine and built on an endo steel chassis. The engine is capable of pushing the 'Mech up to speeds of 151 km/h, and with the experimental supercharger engaged the Porcupine is capable of speeds of up to 194 km/h in open terrain. Protection for the Porcupine is provided by three and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor which has had spikes embedded in it, giving the 'Mech greater damage potential when performing a charging attack than its laser weapons.

content.original: Almost an entirely different 'Mech, this version drops the supercharged 180-rated XL engine for a smaller, lighter, but considerably more expensive, 160-rated XXL engine and swaps the spikes and ferro-fibrous armor for cosmetically enhanced standard plating. The lighter engine and use of a small cockpit gives the PRC-2N enough space and tonnage to feature two ER medium lasers, two small X-Pulse lasers, and an ER small laser in addition to the four standard medium lasers of the PRC-1N. While a deadly close quarters combatant, even with an upgrade to double heat sinks PRC-2N can only vent half the waste heat generated by all the extra weaponry and its experimental power plant. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: A departure from the attempt to emulate the Mad Cat, the 2A model removes the 'Mechs arsenal and upgrades it with a new weapons mix geared toward close combat. The primary weapon is a rotary autocannon/5. This is backed up at shorter ranges by a Large Pulse Laser and for point-blank combat, the 'Mech carries four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The Rakshasa was designed by engineers at the New Avalon Institute of Science in an attempt to copy the Mad Cat . The finished product, while not as powerful as the OmniMech it emulates, is a powerful 'Mech with an undeserved bad reputation. The Rakshasa is powered by a GM 375 XL engine and built on a GM Marauder Special MD Endo Steel chassis to save weight and allow the 'Mech to carry as similar a weapons payload as possible to the Mad Cat.

content.original: The SA-RN7 is built on an endo steel chassis, and is powered by a 250 XL engine that allows the 'Mech to move up to 86.4 km/h. Protection is provided by nine and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The main armament is the large pulse laser and a pair of LRM-10 launchers fed by two tons of ammunition. These are backed up by a single ER small laser, a claw, and two M-Pods. The 'Mech's waste heat is managed by the standard 10 double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech introduced by Solaris Arms in the mid-3050. As their entry in the medium range weight class arenas, the original Ronin was based on a Centurion chassis. By using an existing chassis rather than building a custom one, Solaris Arms was able to reduce development time and costs. This design philosophy, pioneered with the Ronin, remains in place today. The 'Mech features balanced speed, armor, and weaponry, making it very popular with the Solaris stables, but it is a rare sight on any other world.

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Efficient Motive System Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Efficient Motive System Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Salamander design incorporates fire-based weapons, its primary armaments being a pair of flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot Short-Range Missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Это делает «Саламандру» особенно эффективной против пехоты и боевой техники, хотя это не значит, что она менее устрашающа и для мехвоинов: мало кто захочет попасться на прицел поинту «Саламандр». Особенность: Fire Demon Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Paired ER Large and ER Medium Lasers form the bulk of the Mechs weapons while a TAG adds the capability for directing artillery strikes. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Silver Fox uses a large but light engine to provide a lot of speed for low weight. The increased size of this engine leaves little room for weapons, but given how fast the Silver Fox is this usually isn't a problem. To protect the 'Mech, Innovative Design Concepts added seven tons of reflective armor, which while only as effective as standard armor against missiles or autocannons, provides superior protection against energy weapons common to the arenas. To provide more protection, IDC additionally installed an ECM suite in the 'Mech's right torso.

content.original: Since the Spirit is primarily a reconnaissance 'Mech, it heavily relies on the use of energy weapons so that it can move far from supply lines. At long range, the Spirit makes use of its ER large laser and a LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS accompanying it. The missile launcher is a somewhat controversial addition to the design, since it uses ammunition, but the extra striking power afforded the light 'Mech was deemed worthwhile. Up close, the Spirit mounts a heavy medium laser and heavy small laser, as well as a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Since the Streak launcher does not waste ammunition, there was no question of its usefulness on this design. 11 double heat sinks strain to keep the 'Mech cool under the energy heavy loadout. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Spirit is one of the first Clan 'Mechs produced in the Inner Sphere. Though some components are imported from Clan space, the 245 XL engine is made in the Clan Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. The engine is only one of the weight-saving technologies the design makes use of, however, as the Spirit incorporates both an endo steel structure and six tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Spirit itself is a relatively fast recon 'Mech that can hold its own at both long and short ranges. In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tessen began as a joint project between the Draconis Combine and ComStar to build a heavy scout 'Mech. The project fell through and was left unfinished until ComStar continued the project independently when they were looking for a new 'Mech to deploy the new improved C3 system when it was initially developed. The Tessen is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a lightweight Vlar 300 XL engine, giving the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h.

content.original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.

content.content: Созданный по образцу омнимеха Thor, используемого Кланами, Thanatos отличается невероятной прочностью и мощью. Копируя как внешний вид, так и возможности кланового Thor, Thanatos является быстрой машиной, способной действовать на всех дистанциях, хотя для меха такого размера он немного скуповат в плане брони. Оснащенный ER Large Laser для дальних дистанций, парой усовершенствованных средних лазеров и MRM-20 для средних и ближних дистанций, Thanatos имеет оружие для любой ситуации. В сочетании с высокой максимальной скоростью 86,4 км/ч и пятью прыжковыми двигателями, Thanatos часто может догнать то, что не может перестрелять.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Торнадо» — это легкая боевая броня, созданная КомСтаром в конце XXIX века для обеспечения дополнительной защиты юнитов специального назначения. Tornado основан на костюме Nighthawk от СОЗЛ, который, хотя КомСтар и приобрели несколько экземпляров, в то время не могли производить. Он включает в себя стелс-броню и адаптивную систему камуфляжа, которая имитирует эффект комбинированного камуфляжного/инфракрасного/электронного противодействия Sneak Suit, скрывая Tornado от всех типов датчиков. Броня также достаточно хороша, чтобы остановить огонь из стрелкового оружия и даже тяжелого оружия, такого как огнемет, и не дать ему повредить носителя. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8848 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Venom was built in direct response to losses suffered by the Draconis Combine and to boost sales for Nimakachi Fusion Products Limited. The company, which at the time was producing only the Spider, was forced to comply with an order by the Coordinator himself that 'Mech manufacturers make up for the losses suffered by the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.

content.original: The Verfolger VR5-R carries a variety of weapons systems with the capability to engage an enemy at almost any range. For its long range striking capabilities, the design carries a powerful ER PPC. As an enemy unit closes, it faces increasing volumes of fire as the Verfolger's LB-X Autocannon/10 comes into play against any enemy units. For close combat, the Verfolger adds its three medium lasers to its short range arsenal, making the 'Mech a powerful infighter. It also has CASE in its side torsos to prevent the total destruction of the 'Mech in an ammunition explosion. To protect itself from missile-carrying units, the Verfolger has an anti-missile system. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Designed to work with the lightweight Wolfhound BattleMech, the Verfolger (German for 'Pursuer') and Wolfhound together are capable of taking out much larger BattleMechs. The Verfolger is built on a lightweight Endo Steel chassis and is powered by a 325 XL engine that sacrifices durability for lighter weight and propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The 'Mech uses its saved weight to carry an impressive twelve and a half tons of armor that allows the Verfolger to stand up to fire from most enemy units that it would encounter.

content.original: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Armed with a single Support PPC, the Void is capable of moderate suppressing fire against larger targets. The stealth armor ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields. Quirk: Void Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

The 03FC model also carries a C3 slave unit to share targeting data with allied units. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Gauss Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Armor for the -13S is a hefty fifteen tons of standard armor, fully 97% of the theoretical maximum for an 80-ton BattleMech. Primary weapons include an ER PPC, an ER Large Laser and an Ultra AC 20. Rounding out this impressive array is a single Medium Pulse Laser for close-in work on infantry and battle armor. The -13S is intended to close at top speed in battalion strength, firing all the way, deploying in a 'hedgehog' formation which ensures many of this design will reach their opponents untouched. Seventeen Double Heat Sinks guarantee the pilot can sustain maximum fire without any heat issues. None of the weapons has a minimum range. Once into the Ultra AC 20's short or medium range, the pilot merely disengages his ER Large Laser, slaves the Ultra AC 20 in its place and continues firing. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 15 Left 100 15 Right 100 15 Rear 85 15 Total 475 75 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting

content.original: The Achileus was jointly designed by scientists from the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake with the goal of creating a light battle armor suit that could be mass produced. Inspired by the Federated Commonwealth's ultimately flawed Infiltrator Mk. I, the research team used the Blakist Tornado PA(L) as the basis for the new suit while seeking to overcome some of its defects. The resulting Achileus manages to add armoring, weaponry and integrated jump jets while still maintaining its stealth aspects. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Afreet is a battle armor design created by Clan Ice Hellion. The Afreet was created when Khan Raina Montose ordered two other projects merged, resulting in a battlesuit that seems to fit in well with the Hellion belief in speed over all else. The primary feature of the Afreet is its ability to leap one hundred twenty meters at a time. This comes at a sacrifice to armor, as the Afreet is only able to stop a Clan ER Small Laser. It does, however, use Improved Sensors, a holdover from one of the suits it descended from. Following the Hellion invasion of the Inner Sphere, both Clan Jade Falcon and Clan Hell's Horses salvaged and produced their own versions. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: «Африт» — это боевая броня, разработанная кланом Ледяного Хеллиона. «Африт» был создан после того, как хан Райна Монтозе приказала объединить два других проекта, в результате чего получился боевой костюм, который, похоже, хорошо вписывается в веру Хеллионов в превосходство скорости над всем остальным. Главной особенностью «Африта» является его способность прыгать на сто двадцать метров за раз. Это достигается за счёт снижения брони, «Африт» способен выдержать огонь максимум одного малого ER-лазера. Однако он использует улучшенные сенсоры, унаследованные от одного из костюмов, от которого он произошёл. После вторжения Хеллионов во Внутреннюю Сферу, клан Нефритового Сокола и клан Адских Лошадей собрали и создали свои собственные версии. Особенность: Шустрый Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Balar was designed by Luthien Armor Works and released alongside the Avatar as a competitor to the Inner Sphere's first OmniMech design. While the Avatar was based upon the clan's Vulture OmniMech, the Balar took cues from the Ebon Jaguar instead. Sporting an impressive 350-rated XL fusion engine, the Balar was fast for a 70-ton 'Mech, but prohibitively expensive, which ultimately caused the design to be mostly overlooked by Combine procurement agents. content.content: «Балар» был разработан компанией Luthien Armor Works и выпущен одновременно с Avatar в качестве конкурента первой модели омнимеха, созданной во Внутренней Сфере. В то время как Avatar был основан на клановом омнимехе Vulture, Balar был создан по образцу Ebon Jaguar. Оснащенный впечатляющим двигателем 350 XL, Balar был быстрым для 70-тонного меха, но чрезмерно дорогим, что в конечном итоге привело к тому, что его конструкция была в основном проигнорирована закупщиками Синдиката. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

While the Avatar was based upon the clan's Vulture OmniMech, the Balar took cues from the Ebon Jaguar instead. Sporting an impressive 350-rated XL fusion engine, the Balar was fast for a 70-ton 'Mech, but prohibitively expensive, which ultimately caused the design to be mostly overlooked by Combine procurement agents. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
content.content: «Балар» был разработан компанией Luthien Armor Works и выпущен одновременно с Avatar в качестве конкурента первой модели омнимеха, созданной во Внутренней Сфере. В то время как Avatar был основан на клановом омнимехе Vulture, Balar был создан по образцу Ebon Jaguar. Оснащенный впечатляющим двигателем 350 XL, Balar был быстрым для 70-тонного меха, но чрезмерно дорогим, что в конечном итоге привело к тому, что его конструкция была в основном проигнорирована закупщиками Синдиката. Особенность: Узкий/низкий профиль Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05 Лимит приводов рук: Omni

content.original: The BL-12 was probably the most technologically advanced version of the Black Knight leading up to the Jihad. While still based on the original BL-6 model this design goes in a completely different direction from the BL-9. Introduced in 3063 the first thing that was done to the BL-12 was the upgrade of all of the medium lasers and the PPC to extended range versions, then its single heat sinks were upgraded to double strength versions, reducing the total number from twenty to sixteen. Finally, all of the weapons were mated to a Targeting Computer. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The BL-13 was developed by the Free Worlds League, based on the surviving BL-7-KNT models. While it keeps the original large lasers, the remaining weapons were all replaced by a Gauss rifle with two tons of ammunition, three extended range medium lasers and a head-mounted ER small laser. To improve the cooling the 'Mech was also switched to mount ten double heat sinks, Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

content.original: The Black Knight BL-15-KNT is an upgrade of the BL6-KNT. The antiquated single heat sinks were removed, along with the standard armor and all but three medium lasers. The BL-15-KNT instead mounts thirteen double heat sinks, a Gauss rifle, two ER large lasers, and three medium lasers. As a weight-saving measure, the BL-15 also uses ferro-fibrous armor. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11

Though not as heavily armored as some other ProtoMechs, the design's high speed prevents most opponents from getting a target lock. The Cecerops is armed with a single ER Micro Laser. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96

content.original: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Клановая боевая броня создана на основе костюма элементалей, внешний вид которого свидетельствует о том, что контакт Кланов с Синдикатом Дракона уже сказывался на них. Несмотря на низкую наземную скорость, разработчики использовали прыжковый ускоритель, впервые разработанный на броне Gray Death Scout, чтобы поднять его на высоту до ста двадцати метров. Это потребовало небольшого уменьшения толщины брони и переделки вооружения. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Debuting during the FedCom Civil War but not gaining traction until recently, the Command COM-7T, also known as the 'Blazing Inferno II', carries the spirit of the popular Succession Wars variant into a new age. This refit runs hot even with its double heat sinks, but the installation of Triple-Strength Myomers turns the heat into a benefit. Though still a competent scout, the COM-7T's prodigious volume of fire more often sees it deployed as a striker. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98

However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive. Quirk: Inspiring Appearance Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: Named for the demonic wolf of Germanic myth, the Fenrir was less a traditional battle suit and more a mobile fire support platform. The trooper controlling the suit was situated inside a cramped "cockpit" and piloted the Fenrir like a small walking tank. The single, configurable turret mounted on the suit could accept a wide variety of weapon configurations and the Fenrir's sturdy, powerful legs could propel it to much greater speeds than the Sloth. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Названный в честь демонического волка из германских мифов, «Фенрир» представлял собой скорее мобильную платформу огневой поддержки, чем традиционный боевой костюм. Управляющий костюмом боец ​​располагался в тесной «кабине» и пилотировал «Фенрир», словно небольшой шагающий танк. Единственная настраиваемая турель, установленная на костюме, могла нести широкий спектр вооружения, а крепкие и мощные ноги «Фенрира» позволяли ему развивать гораздо большую скорость, чем было у Sloth. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Golem is a battle armor design that was created by Clan Ghost Bear. Following their conflicts with first the Draconis Combine, then Clan Hell's Horses, the Bears decided they wanted something that could compete with the Kanazuchi and Gnome. The Golem is the result of that process and features enough armor to shrug off a Heavy Large Laser. In addition, this armor is fire resistant, so it is unaffected by Flamers and Inferno rounds. Though it cannot jump, the Golem is still speedier than the other assault-class designs. While that does not make this battlesuit fast, it does give it the ability to bring its strong weapons to bear on a target, even as it can withstand the punishment meted out by an enemy. Quirk: Armored Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.96 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Голем» — это проект боевой брони, созданной кланом Призрачного Медведя. После конфликтов сначала с Синдикатом Дракона, а затем с кланом Адских Лошадей, Медведи решили, что им нужно что-то, что могло бы конкурировать с «Каназучи» и «Гномами». «Голем» — результат этого решения. Он обладает достаточной броней, чтобы не обращать внимания даже на тяжелый большой лазер. Кроме того, эта броня огнестойка, поэтому она не подвержена воздействию огнеметов и снарядов «Инферно». Хотя он не может прыгать, «Голем» всё ещё быстрее прочих штурмовых костюмов. Пусть это не значит, что эта броня очень быстрая, она может донести свое мощное оружие до цели, даже находясь под сильным огнём. Особенность: Бронированный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.96 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Grenadier is a battle armor design created by the Hahm-Heinz Design Bureau. The firm has long had a relationship with General Motors' secondary plants on Talcott and Salem, so when the NAIS first started creating battle armor, Hahm-Heinz had access to prototypes that they could work from. The armor is where the Grenadier is lacking, having only enough to stop an Inner Sphere Large Pulse Laser, the same amount as the venerable Inner Sphere Standard. This armor, however, is standard stealth armor, so the Grenadier is a bit more difficult to target. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.896 Can only be transported by internal bays, can melee, can not swarm.

content.content: «Гренадер» — это боевая броня, разработанная конструкторским бюро Hahm-Heinz. Компания давно сотрудничает со вспомогательными заводами General Motors в Талкотте и Салеме, поэтому, когда NAIS впервые приступила к созданию боевой брони, Hahm-Heinz получила доступ к прототипам, на основе которых можно было работать. Броня — это слабое место Гренадера, поскольку она способна остановить только большой импульсный лазер Внутренней Сферы, то есть столько же, сколько и у почтенного Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Однако эта броня является стандартной стелс-броней, поэтому Гренадер несколько сложнее для выцеливания. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.896 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, может в ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti-air and anti-mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either its own launcher or the rest of its lancemates. The designs speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with its armor unable to stand up to much punishment. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

Built around a 120-rated XL Engine the Howler HWR-2 uses a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 4 ATM-3’s with 2 tons of ammo. MASC boosts the Mechs speed. content.original: The Infiltrator Mk. II is a battle armor suit designed as a replacement for the earlier Infiltrator Mk. I. With better armament and protection than its predecessor, the Mk. II was superior in all ways except cost. A battle armor-scale Magshot rifle provides firepower while an anti-infantry SMG provides light defense. A suite of stealth armor keeps the suit protected on the field. The only serious downside is the slow ground speed of the Mk. II, though jump jets help keep the suit semi-mobile. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.
