content.content: «Инфильтратор Мк II» - это боевая броня, разработанная в качестве замены более ранней модели Infiltrator Mk I. Обладая лучшим вооружением и защитой, Mk II превзошёл своего предшественника по всем параметрам, кроме стоимости. Боевая винтовка Magshot обеспечивает огневую мощь, а противопехотный SMG - легкую защиту. Защиту на поле боя обеспечивает и комплект стелс-брони. Единственным серьезным недостатком Mk II является низкая скорость передвижения по земле, хотя прыжковые двигатели позволяют поддерживать какую-никакую мобильность. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Стандарт Внутренней Сферы был разработан после вторжения Кланов, когда державы Внутренней Сферы спешили воспроизвести технологию боевой брони Кланов. Однако, не имея никаких частей с полей сражений, инженеры были вынуждены работать на основе древних слухов о ранних силовых бронекостюмах типа Nighthawk, больше похожих на бронированные экзоскелеты, чем на тех «жаб», что встречались им в настоящее время, и их прототипы плохо показывали себя во время испытаний. Настоящий толчок в изучении боевой брони дали трофеи с первых побед над Кланами. Научный институт Нового Авалона первым частично воспроизвел броню элементалей в виде Стандарта Внутренней Сферы. Особенность: Стандартные запчасти Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.892 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Inner Sphere Standard was developed following the initial thrust of the Clan invasion, as Inner Sphere powers rushed to duplicate the battle armor technology the Clans fielded. Lacking any battlefield salvage on which to base their development though, engineers were forced to work off of ancient rumors of early power armor suits like the Nighthawk, more akin to armored Exoskeletons than the 'Toads' currently rampaging through known space, and these prototypes fared poorly during testing. It took salvage from the first victories over the Clans to truly kick-start the development of battle armor. The New Avalon Institute of Science was the first to reproduce in part the Clans' Elemental armor as the Inner Sphere Standard. Quirk: Standard Parts Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Kage (translating to "shadow" in japanese) light battle armor was one of the first battle armor designs produced by the Draconis Combine after the Truce of Tukayyid. Built for reconnaissance and battlefield infiltration, development of the Kage was a joint operation between Internal Security Force scientists and Draconis Elite Strike Team advisers. Indeed the Kage was meant to provide an alternative to the much-respected DEST Infiltration Suit for missions in which DEST teams could expect heavy opposition, and since production started in 3056 the battle armor has virtually replaced the older Sneak Suit. Quirk: Ambusher Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.886 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.content: Лёгкая боевая броня «Каге» (что в переводе с японского означает «тень») была одним из первых образцов боевой брони, созданных Синдикатом Дракона после Туккаидского перемирия. Разработанная для разведки и проникновения на поле боя, «Каге» стала совместной операцией учёных Сил Внутренней Безопасности и советников Элитной ударной группы Дракона (DEST). «Каге» задумывался как альтернатива высоко ценимому Infiltration бронекостюму DEST для миссий, в которых отряды DEST могли ожидать серьёзного сопротивления, и с начала производства в 3056 году эта боевая броня фактически заменила устаревший Sneak Suit. Особенность: Налётчик Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.886 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: As Autocannon development continued in the early 3060s, rotary autocannons became available. The MAL-2D gained mass for the increasingly massive cannons by downgrading the shoulder box launchers to medium-range missiles. As both the lasers and missiles were now all but vestigial, the MAL-2D became a developmental cul-de-sac. Though doubtlessly effective, it had poor mission endurance and did not offer tangible improvements in firepower. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

content.original: The Nighthawk is a PA(L) design and the progenitor of modern battle armor. The original Nighthawk was based upon exoskeletons originally used for commercial purposes during the Star League. It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

It took fifteen years and twenty prototypes before the SLDF finally perfected the design that would eventually be produced. A working prototype was first introduced in 2718, which was followed by two years of field testing and, finally, full production, entering service with the Special Forces Command. Особенность: Power Armor Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.8848 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: Originally developed for use in the arenas of Solaris VII, the 9SS is produced by Norse-Storm. The long-range weaponry of the 9J is removed and replaced with an Ultra Autocannon/20 and an LB-X Autocannon/20. The two guns are each incredibly powerful at short range, enabling the 9SS to obliterate enemies incredibly quickly. Three tons of ammunition for each ensure that this variant of the Nightstar has some staying power. A half of a ton of armor is removed to make way for three jump jets, enabling the 9SS to vault up to ninety meters at a time so that it can more effectively bring its autocannons to bear. Three Medium Pulse Lasers back up the autocannons and provide the only firepower should they run out of ammunition. Also of note is the loss of both lower arm and hand actuators to make space for the weapons and equipment fielded. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The main gun of the Ocelot 1 is its heavy large laser, which is capable of significant damage for its size, though it suffers from inaccuracy. To back that up, the Ocelot 1 mounts a pair of ER medium lasers that have the same range profile as the large. The use of 15 double heat sinks keep the Ocelot 1 fairly cool, though non-stop firing and maneuvers via jump jets will eventually result in significant heat buildup. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06

content.original: The Pack Hunter is the first new design produced by Clan Wolf-in-Exile on Arc-Royal. It also represents a new partnership between Phelan's Wolves and the Kell Hounds, as the armor and communications gear are Kell Hound products, traded to the Wolves in exchange for Endo Steel. Reflecting their Khan's bias towards light, fast designs, Wolf scientists designed the Pack Hunter to be fast and have a sharp bite. Though its four tons of armor are light, the BattleMech is supposed to use its speed and maneuverability to stay out of trouble. Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05

content.content: «Пак Хантер» — первый новый проект, созданный кланом Волка-в-изгнании на Арк-Ройяле. Он также представляет собой результат нового партнёрства между Волками Фелана и Гончими Келла, поскольку броня и средства связи изготовлены Гончими и были переданы Волкам в обмен на эндосталь. Следуя за стремлением их хана к лёгким и быстрым конструкциям, учёные Волка разработали Pack Hunter таким образом, чтобы он был быстрым и обладал болючим укусом. Несмотря на лёгкость четырёхтонной брони, этот боевой мех должен использовать свою скорость и манёвренность, чтобы оставаться в стороне от неприятностей. Особенность: Укреплённые ноги Множитель стоимости высадки: 1.05

content.original: The largest gun on the Pinion is its heavy large laser. Although it experiences some targeting difficulties, it packs a strong punch into a relatively small package. On the opposite end of the spectrum are the four micro pulse lasers mounted in the Pinion's torso. These weapons are only useful at point-blank range, but the pulse technology makes them quite accurate, and make the Pinion devastating against conventional infantry. The medium pulse lasers have a decent range and are highly accurate and provide reliable, mid-range firepower. This all-energy weapon configuration allows the 'Mech to range far and wide without having to worry about resupply or ammunition explosions in combat. 14 double heat sinks keeps the 'Mech fairly cool, though an alpha strike will seriously overheat it. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

content.original: Almost an entirely different 'Mech, this version drops the supercharged 180-rated XL engine for a smaller, lighter, but considerably more expensive, 160-rated XXL engine and swaps the spikes and ferro-fibrous armor for cosmetically enhanced standard plating. The lighter engine and use of a small cockpit gives the PRC-2N enough space and tonnage to feature two ER medium lasers, two small X-Pulse lasers, and an ER small laser in addition to the four standard medium lasers of the PRC-1N. While a deadly close quarters combatant, even with an upgrade to double heat sinks PRC-2N can only vent half the waste heat generated by all the extra weaponry and its experimental power plant. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97

content.original: The Purifier Adaptive battle armor is produced by Word of Blake, though the original data was stolen from ComStar. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.868 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

Purifier Adaptive является революционной в том смысле, что в ней используется адаптивная броня, меняющая цвет. Адаптивная броня делает Purifier Adaptive гораздо более сложной мишенью, особенно когда она находится в неподвижном состоянии. Недостатком является количество брони, которое она несет. Адаптивная броня делает Purifier Adaptive гораздо более сложной мишенью, особенно когда она находится в неподвижном состоянии. Недостатком является количество брони, которое она несет. Особенность: Точный Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.868 Может крепиться на омни-юниты, может ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Purifier Adaptive battle armor is produced by Word of Blake, though the original data was stolen from ComStar. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries. Quirk: Accurate Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

It is essentially the Combine's take on the Inner Sphere Standard which, though debuting first and also produced by the Kuritans themselves, represents an improvement on the design. Quirk: Well Designed Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

The primary weapon is a rotary autocannon/5. This is backed up at shorter ranges by a Large Pulse Laser and for point-blank combat, the 'Mech carries four Medium Pulse Lasers. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The SA-RN7 is built on an endo steel chassis, and is powered by a 250 XL engine that allows the 'Mech to move up to 86.4 km/h. Protection is provided by nine and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The main armament is the large pulse laser and a pair of LRM-10 launchers fed by two tons of ammunition. These are backed up by a single ER small laser, a claw, and two M-Pods. The 'Mech's waste heat is managed by the standard 10 double heat sinks. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

content.original: Designed as a fast foot scout for battle armor units, the Rottweiler pushes the envelope of what ground speed battle armor can reach. Clad in BA-grade stealth armor and equipped with ECM, the Rottweiler makes for a hard target. However, this speed and evasiveness comes with a price: the Rottweiler is lightly armed. Each suit carries a Small Laser as primary armament and carries a Firedrake incendiary needler as a backup weapon. While not a lot of firepower, it was judged to be acceptable by the Lyran Alliance and the suit was put into production. Quirk: Efficient Motive System Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.888 Can only be transported by internal bays, can not melee, can not swarm.

content.content: Разработанный как быстрый пеший разведчик для юнитов бронепехоты, «Ротвейлер» выходит за рамки наземных скоростных возможностей обычной боевой брони. Облачённый в стелс-броню для экзокостюмов и оснащённый системой РЭБ, «Ротвейлер» представляет собой серьёзную цель. Однако эта скорость и уклончивость имеют свою цену: «Ротвейлер» легко вооружён. Каждый костюм оснащён малым лазером в качестве основного оружия и зажигательным игольником Firedrake в качестве запасного. Несмотря на невысокую огневую мощь, броня была признана приемлемой Лиранским Альянсом, и он был запущен в производство. Особенность: Efficient Motive System Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.888 Может перевозиться только во внутренних отсеках, не может ближний бой, не может swarm-атаки.

content.original: The Salamander design incorporates fire-based weapons, its primary armaments being a pair of flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot Short-Range Missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat vehicles, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to MechWarriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point. Quirk: Fire Demon Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.93 Can mount any unit, can melee, can swarm.

Это делает «Саламандру» особенно эффективной против пехоты и боевой техники, хотя это не значит, что она менее устрашающа и для мехвоинов: мало кто захочет попасться на прицел поинту «Саламандр». Особенность: Fire Demon Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.93 Может крепиться на любом юните, может в ближний бой, может swarm-атаки.

Paired ER Large and ER Medium Lasers form the bulk of the Mechs weapons while a TAG adds the capability for directing artillery strikes. The twenty five-ton design is one of the fastest in existence, allowing it to pick off enemy units that stray too far from support like a lioness hunting a pack of wildebeest. The Solitaire is capable of operating far from supply lines, as it carries an all-energy weapon complement and four and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02

content.original: Since the Spirit is primarily a reconnaissance 'Mech, it heavily relies on the use of energy weapons so that it can move far from supply lines. At long range, the Spirit makes use of its ER large laser and a LRM-10 launcher with an Artemis IV FCS accompanying it. The missile launcher is a somewhat controversial addition to the design, since it uses ammunition, but the extra striking power afforded the light 'Mech was deemed worthwhile. Up close, the Spirit mounts a heavy medium laser and heavy small laser, as well as a Streak SRM-4 launcher. Since the Streak launcher does not waste ammunition, there was no question of its usefulness on this design. 11 double heat sinks strain to keep the 'Mech cool under the energy heavy loadout. Quirk: Improved Jammer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

content.original: The Sylph was created by Clan Cloud Cobra to augment their vast aerospace forces with a fully-airborne battle armor suit. Naming it after elemental spirits representing air, development of the suit was driven as much by the Cloud Cobra's faith as it was by Khan Din Steiner's orders. Despite their scientist caste's vast knowledge of aircraft, the Clan had a great deal of trouble getting the VTOL capabilities of the Sylph to function, with a number of test pilots dying during its secretive development. As it is, the Sylph only possesses limited flight capabilities, but even this remains an impressive accomplishment. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.9475 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Tornado is a Power Armor (Light) suit, created by ComStar in the late twenty-ninth century to equip their special forces units with added protection. The Tornado is based on the Star League Defense Force Nighthawk suit which, though they had acquired several, ComStar at the time was unable to produce. It incorporates stealth armor and an adaptive Camo System which mimics the effects of a combination Camo/IR/ECM Sneak Suit, hiding the Tornado from all types of sensors. The armor is also good enough to stop small-arms fire and even heavy weapons like a Flamer from hurting the wearer. Quirk: Power Armor Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.8848 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can swarm.

content.original: The Verfolger VR5-R carries a variety of weapons systems with the capability to engage an enemy at almost any range. For its long range striking capabilities, the design carries a powerful ER PPC. As an enemy unit closes, it faces increasing volumes of fire as the Verfolger's LB-X Autocannon/10 comes into play against any enemy units. For close combat, the Verfolger adds its three medium lasers to its short range arsenal, making the 'Mech a powerful infighter. It also has CASE in its side torsos to prevent the total destruction of the 'Mech in an ammunition explosion. To protect itself from missile-carrying units, the Verfolger has an anti-missile system. Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09

Armed with a single Support PPC, the Void is capable of moderate suppressing fire against larger targets. The stealth armor ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields. content.original: Armor for the -13S is a hefty fifteen tons of standard armor, fully 97% of the theoretical maximum for an 80-ton BattleMech. Primary weapons include an ER PPC, an ER Large Laser and an Ultra AC 20. Rounding out this impressive array is a single Medium Pulse Laser for close-in work on infantry and battle armor. The -13S is intended to close at top speed in battalion strength, firing all the way, deploying in a 'hedgehog' formation which ensures many of this design will reach their opponents untouched. Seventeen Double Heat Sinks guarantee the pilot can sustain maximum fire without any heat issues. None of the weapons has a minimum range. Once into the Ultra AC 20's short or medium range, the pilot merely disengages his ER Large Laser, slaves the Ultra AC 20 in its place and continues firing. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper

content.original: The genesis of the Nightstar lies in the Amaris Civil War. The 'Mech itself was only produced until the the First Succession War, when both of the factories and engineers capable of producing the Nightstar were destroyed or killed. The Nightstar is armed to keep an enemy at standoff ranges. The primary weapons carried are a pair of Gauss Rifles, each of which can strip almost a ton of armor off an enemy unit. These are backed up by a ER PPC that is capable of hitting a target at six hundred and ninety meters. For defense at short ranges, the 'Mech has two Medium Pulse Lasers and an Small Laser.

content.original: Like many Solaris VII arena 'Mechs, the Spatha is designed as a brawler, but relies upon finesse rather than brute strength like most. A hand-tooled 360-rated XXL engine trades durability for tremendous weight savings but the Spatha only has to fear autocannon or gauss rifle fire on its fragile engine thanks to its eleven tons of advanced reflective armor and Laser AMS negating its opponents' energy and missile weaponry. The Spatha's thirteen double heat sinks are barely up the task of cooling its advanced power plant and its own energy weapons, actually an intentional choice given the Spatha is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer to boost its speed and dramatically boost the effectiveness of its sword.

The Grayson configuration is armed with two Autocannon/5s for long range combat and has four ER medium lasers for close combat. The autocannons and lasers are all linked to a Targeting Computer for increased accuracy. To seek out weak points in an enemy's armor, the Grayson configuration has two Streak SRM-4 launchers. In order to handle its heat load more easily, this configuration has an additional double heat sink and also has three jump jets, which allow it to jump up to ninety meters. content.original: Intended to emulate the Thor OmniMech used by the Clans, the Thanatos is an incredibly sturdy and hard-hitting design. Copying both the looks and the capabilities of the Clan Thor, the Thanatos is a fast all-range design, though it skimps on armor a bit for a mech its size. Carrying an ER Large Laser for long range and a brace of advanced medium lasers and a MRM-20 for medium to close range, the Thanatos has a weapon for any situation. Combined with a fast 86.4 km/h top speed and five jump jets, the Thanatos can often catch what it cannot out-range.

content.original: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Volkh was originally designed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team to serve as a testbed for advanced technology. VEST designers used an XXL Engine to provide enough weight savings to mount the heavy armor. To provide bursts of additional speed, they also fitted a Supercharger to the engine. This allows the Volkh to boost its speed to 97 km/h briefly. This is usually enough to close or evade an opponent. For survivability, the Volkh uses hardened armor and a Torso-Mounted Cockpit. MechWarriors who use the Volkh are more willing to get in close to an opponent, trusting that the heavy armor surrounding the cockpit will protect them from weapons fire.

content.original: The No-Dachi was designed by Cosby as a test bed for two new technologies. The first was the Sword. The seven-meter long katana that the 'Mech wields was designed to counter the Hatchet used by some Federated Commonwealth 'Mechs. Because the samurai mindset had been so successfully drilled into the warriors of the Draconis Combine, they were loathe to use a ''barbaric'' ax. The second new technology was the Triple Strength Myomer that had been pioneered by the Federated Suns. The new melee weapon, combined with the improved myomers, make the No-Dachi a dangerous in-fighter.

content.original: A vicious anti-infantry variant, the origin of the Flea "Fire Ant" is a mystery, with Earthwerks denying the design. It was first seen in the Chaos March, most notably in urban fighting on Carver V, in 3063 and none were spotted after 3068. Possibly the predecessor to the 19 and 20, the exact configuration is not known (if one even exists, as it seems to be a refit variant of sorts). The typical Fire Ant refit removed half a ton of armor in favor of six Machine Guns and three Flamers. It was thought to be a designated pacification unit, in the sense of a SecurityMech, as opposed to a frontline BattleMech design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Злой вариант для борьбы с пехотой. Происхождение этой Flea «Fire Ant» остаётся загадкой, поскольку Earthwerks отрицает его разработку. Впервые он был замечен на Марше Хаоса, в частности в городских боях на Carver V в 3063 году, и после 3068 года больше не появлялся. Возможно, это предшественник моделей -19 и -20, но точная конфигурация неизвестна (если она вообще существует, так как, по-видимому, это своего рода модифицированный вариант). Типичная модификация Fire Ant предполагала удаление полутонны брони в пользу шести пулеметов и трех огнеметов. Считалось, что это был спец юнит для усмирения беспорядков, мех охраны, в отличие от фронтовой модели боевого меха. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

Впервые он был замечен на Марше Хаоса, в частности в городских боях на Carver V в 3063 году, и после 3068 года больше не появлялся. Возможно, это предшественник моделей -19 и -20, но точная конфигурация неизвестна (если она вообще существует, так как, по-видимому, это своего рода модифицированный вариант). Типичная модификация Fire Ant предполагала удаление полутонны брони в пользу шести пулеметов и трех огнеметов. Считалось, что это был спец юнит для усмирения беспорядков, мех охраны, в отличие от фронтовой модели боевого меха.

content.original: First introduced by the Terran Hegemony in 2568, the Phoenix Hawk was one of the most famous BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere. The 'Mech began life when Orguss Industries realized that it could reinforce the Stinger chassis to create a larger version, one with the same speed and maneuverability as the Stinger but with superior armor, firepower, and electronics. Originally a staple of the SLDF, Phoenix Hawks remained common within the armies of the Successor States after the fall of the Star League. At first Phoenix Hawks were grouped together to form powerful recon lances, but as they started reaching their various deployments, their full potential as command 'Mechs was discovered and many were reassigned to instead lead units of smaller recon 'Mechs.

content.content: Впервые представленный Терранской гегемонией в 2568 году, Phoenix Hawk был одним из самых известных боевых мехов во Внутренней Сфере. Этот мех появился, когда Orguss Industries поняли, что могут усилить шасси Stinger, чтобы породить более крупную версию, обладающую той же скоростью и маневренностью, что и Stinger, но с улучшенной броней, огневой мощью и электроникой. Изначально являясь основной рабочей лошадкой СОЗЛ, «Феникс Хоки» оставались распространенными в армиях государств-наследников после падения Звездной Лиги. Сначала «Феникс Хоки» были объединены в мощные разведывательные отряды, но по мере того, как они начали достигать своих различных мест развертывания, был обнаружен их полный потенциал в качестве командирских мехов, и многие из них были переведены на руководство подразделениями малых развед мехов.

content.original: The 4L was a variant built for the Capellan Confederation by Ceres Metals starting in 3066. The design used a Taurian-produced standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The 'Mech carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially designed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. One of the more radical changes was the use of eight tons of Ceres Metals Stealth Armor, making the Phoenix Hawk harder to target at range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

The 'Mech uses an extralight engine for power and is protected by nine tons of armor, with a full-head ejection system protecting the pilot. content.original: A vicious anti-infantry variant, the origin of the Flea "Fire Ant" is a mystery, with Earthwerks denying the design. It was first seen in the Chaos March, most notably in urban fighting on Carver V, in 3063 and none were spotted after 3068. Possibly the predecessor to the 19 and 20, the exact configuration is not known (if one even exists, as it seems to be a refit variant of sorts). The typical Fire Ant refit removed half a ton of armor in favor of six Machine Guns and three Flamers. It was thought to be a designated pacification unit, in the sense of a SecurityMech, as opposed to a frontline BattleMech design. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.content: Злой вариант для борьбы с пехотой. Происхождение этой Flea «Fire Ant» остаётся загадкой, поскольку Earthwerks отрицает его разработку. Впервые он был замечен на Марше Хаоса, в частности в городских боях на Carver V в 3063 году, и после 3068 года больше не появлялся. Возможно, это предшественник моделей -19 и -20, но точная конфигурация неизвестна (если она вообще существует, так как, по-видимому, это своего рода модифицированный вариант). Типичная модификация Fire Ant предполагала удаление полутонны брони в пользу шести пулеметов и трех огнеметов. Считалось, что это был спец юнит для усмирения беспорядков, мех охраны, в отличие от фронтовой модели боевого меха. Особенность: Ул. система жизнеобеспечения Множитель стоимости высадки: 0.95 Лимит приводов рук: Left Upper, Right Upper

content.original: The 4L was a variant built for the Capellan Confederation by Ceres Metals starting in 3066. The design used a Taurian-produced standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The 'Mech carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially designed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. One of the more radical changes was the use of eight tons of Ceres Metals Stealth Armor, making the Phoenix Hawk harder to target at range. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03

content.original: The Marauder was first built by General Motors in 2612 for use as an attack and direct fire support BattleMech. The first 'Mech to diverge from the traditional humanoid shape of previous machines, the Marauder was one of the most well-known 'Mechs in existence and originally meant to usher in a new generation of 'Mechs. Unfortunately, with the fall of the Star League, this new generation never quite materialized. On its own merits though, the Marauder was a devastatingly powerful 'Mech, outclassed only by larger machines like the Stalker and BattleMaster. content.content: «Мародер» был впервые построен компанией General Motors в 2612 году для использования в качестве боевого меха первой линии и прямой огневой поддержки. «Мародер» стал первым мехом, отошедшим от традиционного гуманоидного облика предшествующих машин; это был один из самых известных мехов, изначально призванный открыть новую эру в мехостроении. Впрочем, сам по себе «Мародер» был невероятно мощным мехом, уступавшим лишь более крупным машинам, таким как «Сталкер» и «Баттлмастер». content.original: The Bailey armored car is a Gienah Automotive-produced civilian security vehicle first marketed in the mid-thirty-first century. The company exploited recovered Star League technology to enhance vehicle performance. The Bailey was designed to cope with battle armor-equipped infantry, which had steadily become more common. Aside for transporting high-value cargo, it can be used as makeshift armor infantry transport. The Bailey was designed to resist battle armor because of a daring raid that saw several robbers using Gray Death Standard battle armor to open a Knox armored car carrying payroll. Компания использовала восстановленные технологии Звездной лиги для улучшения характеристик техники. «Бейли» был разработан для борьбы с пехотой, оснащенной боевой броней, которая становилась все более распространенным явлением. Помимо перевозки ценных грузов, его можно использовать в качестве импровизированного БМП. Бронемашина «Бейли» была спроектирована для противостояния боевой броне после дерзкого налета, когда несколько грабителей, используя боевую броню Gray Death Standard, взломали бронированный автомобиль «Нокс», перевозивший зарплату. Ограничения биома: нет. Передвижение: 6/9 гексов / 180/270 метров. content.original: The Dragon is a heavy BattleMech originally designed in a bid to replace the Shadow Hawk. A close assault 'Mech, its versatile design allows it to be used in both offensive and defensive operations. It boasts above-average firepower and plenty of ammunition for extended combat, while having a high top speed for a heavy 'Mech. Armor coverage for the Dragon is thick around the torso, and especially the rear, for when it is surrounded by opponents, while the squat design gives it a smaller profile and makes it harder to knock over. The Dragon's only major problem is it requires frequent maintenance and/or overhaul of its hip actuator

The Dragon's only major problem is it requires frequent maintenance and/or overhaul of its hip actuator

Aside for transporting high-value cargo, it can be used as makeshift armor infantry transport.
